Occurrences.Kwic: 過峰西。滿山筍蕨滿園茶，一樹紅花間白花。大抵四時春最好，就中猶好是山家。有人問我何年住，坐久纔方省得來。門外碧桃親手種，春光二十度花開。厭煩勞役愛安閒，箇樣如何居得山？百丈已前巖穴士，生涯全在钁頭邊。年老菴居養病身，日高猶自未開門。怕寒起坐燒松火，一曲樵歌隔塢聞。童子未曾歸動火，水雲早已到投齋。山菴喜免征徭慮，賸種青松只賣柴。玉堂銀燭笙歌夜，金谷羅幃富貴家。爭似道人茅屋下，一天晴月曬梅花。相逢盡說世途難，自向菴中討不安。除却淵明賦歸去，更無一箇肯休官。山厨寂寂斷炊煙，凍鎖泉聲欲雪天。面壁老僧無定力，又思乞食到人間。種了冬瓜便種茄，勞形苦骨做生涯。眾人若要厨堂好，須是園頭常在家。粥去飯來何日了，日生月落幾時休。都來與我無干涉，空起許多閒念頭。屋後青松八九樹，門前紫芋兩三疄。山居道者機關少，家火從頭說向人。此事誰人敢強為，除非知有莫能知。分明月在梅花上，看到梅花早已遲。過去事已過去了，未來不必預思量。只今便道即今句，梅子熟時梔子香。一日打眠三五度，也消不得許多閒。循環數遍琅玕竹，又出青松望遠山。攀緣起倒易消停，卒急難除是愛憎。我笑青山高突兀，青山嫌我廋陵層。真空湛寂惟常在，不覺良田妄所󳬿。真性何曾離妄有，花開花落自春風。天湖水湛琉璃碧，霞霧山圍錦幛紅。觸目本來成現事，何須叉手問禪翁。年老氣衰真箇懶，晨朝更不見和南。客來無語相抵對，辛苦空勞到草菴。老去一身都是懶，閑來百念盡成灰。與兄相見略彈指，無柰人情強接陪。田地無塵長不掃，柴門有客扣方開。雪晴斜月侵簷冷，梅影一枝窓上來。茅屋低低三兩間，團團環遶盡青山。竹牀不許閒雲宿，日未斜時便掩關。禪兄何事到煙蘿，老我生涯苦不多。巖下木樨香滿樹，園中菜甲綠成窠。一片無塵新雨地，半邊有蘚古時松。目前景物人皆見，取用誰知各不同。萬境萬機俱寢息，一知一見盡消融。閒閒兩耳全無用，坐到晨雞與暮鐘。巖房終日寂寥寥，世念何曾有一毫？雖著衣裳喫粥飯，恰如死了未曾燒。新縫紙被烘來煖，一覺安眠到五更。聞得上方鐘皷動，又添一日在浮生。門前枯木似人立，屋後好山如浪堆。老我為人無可說，高高雲路賺兄來。山形凹凸路高低，石占雲頭屋占蹊。地窄栽來蔬菜少，又營小圃在橋西。百千日月閒中度，八萬塵勞靜處消。綠水光中山影轉，紅爐焰上雪花飄。西方有路不肯去，地獄無門鬬要過。金閣銀臺仙子小

ClaimAnchors.Kwic: 過峰西。滿山筍蕨滿園茶，一樹紅花間白花。大抵四時春最好，就中猶好是山家。有人問我何年住，坐久纔方省得來。門外碧桃親手種，春光二十度花開。厭煩勞役愛安閒，箇樣如何居得山？百丈已前巖穴士，生涯全在钁頭邊。年老菴居養病身，日高猶自未開門。怕寒起坐燒松火，一曲樵歌隔塢聞。童子未曾歸動火，水雲早已到投齋。山菴喜免征徭慮，賸種青松只賣柴。玉堂銀燭笙歌夜，金谷羅幃富貴家。爭似道人茅屋下，一天晴月曬梅花。相逢盡說世途難，自向菴中討不安。除却淵明賦歸去，更無一箇肯休官。山厨寂寂斷炊煙，凍鎖泉聲欲雪天。面壁老僧無定力，又思乞食到人間。種了冬瓜便種茄，勞形苦骨做生涯。眾人若要厨堂好，須是園頭常在家。粥去飯來何日了，日生月落幾時休。都來與我無干涉，空起許多閒念頭。屋後青松八九樹，門前紫芋兩三疄。山居道者機關少，家火從頭說向人。此事誰人敢強為，除非知有莫能知。分明月在梅花上，看到梅花早已遲。過去事已過去了，未來不必預思量。只今便道即今句，梅子熟時梔子香。一日打眠三五度，也消不得許多閒。循環數遍琅玕竹，又出青松望遠山。攀緣起倒易消停，卒急難除是愛憎。我笑青山高突兀，青山嫌我廋陵層。真空湛寂惟常在，不覺良田妄所󳬿。真性何曾離妄有，花開花落自春風。天湖水湛琉璃碧，霞霧山圍錦幛紅。觸目本來成現事，何須叉手問禪翁。年老氣衰真箇懶，晨朝更不見和南。客來無語相抵對，辛苦空勞到草菴。老去一身都是懶，閑來百念盡成灰。與兄相見略彈指，無柰人情強接陪。田地無塵長不掃，柴門有客扣方開。雪晴斜月侵簷冷，梅影一枝窓上來。茅屋低低三兩間，團團環遶盡青山。竹牀不許閒雲宿，日未斜時便掩關。禪兄何事到煙蘿，老我生涯苦不多。巖下木樨香滿樹，園中菜甲綠成窠。一片無塵新雨地，半邊有蘚古時松。目前景物人皆見，取用誰知各不同。萬境萬機俱寢息，一知一見盡消融。閒閒兩耳全無用，坐到晨雞與暮鐘。巖房終日寂寥寥，世念何曾有一毫？雖著衣裳喫粥飯，恰如死了未曾燒。新縫紙被烘來煖，一覺安眠到五更。聞得上方鐘皷動，又添一日在浮生。門前枯木似人立，屋後好山如浪堆。老我為人無可說，高高雲路賺兄來。山形凹凸路高低，石占雲頭屋占蹊。地窄栽來蔬菜少，又營小圃在橋西。百千日月閒中度，八萬塵勞靜處消。綠水光中山影轉，紅爐焰上雪花飄。西方有路不肯去，地獄無門鬬要過。金閣銀臺仙子小

ClaimAnchors.Kwic: 共戴天者，如何相見？」「一缽千家飯，孤身萬里游。青目睹人少，問路白雲頭。今朝一飽忘百饑，承誰恩力？」「南北東西歸去來，夜深同看千巖雪。渠無眼耳鼻舌身意，作麼生看？」「撒手到家人不識，更無一物獻尊堂。可憐生，頭角零離，御飯亦吐。尊堂久默斯要，不以筋骨為能。今朝觸目傷心，作何調攝？」「昨從鳥道來，轉入玄路去。智門踏破草鞋，赤腳走玄沙，踰嶺碎卻指頭，血濺梵天，平地上死人無數。國有憲章，未審罪歸何所？」「三日不相見，莫作等閒看。去家千百日，古路草芊芊。所以道：『未有嘗行而不住者，未有嘗住而不行者。』其行也，和光同塵，片雲橫谷口，迷卻幾人源？其住也，破家散宅，父母非我親，誰是最親者？既然家破宅散，且道飲食起居在甚麼處？」「父母非我親，誰是最親者？因甚東家人死，西家助哀？路逢達道人，不將語默對，悠悠兩會心，清風動天地。君子千里同風，正與麼時，山中人兩口無一舌，作何秪對？」「自離左右，乾坤寥廓，不識所從。終日十字街頭化飯喫了，古廟裏閉門高臥，一日打眠三五度，也消不得許多閒。閒不過時，於赤肉團上伐鼓，烈焰堆頭白椎，盡大地撮來如粟米粒大，拋向面前，漆桶不會。四大部洲忍俊不禁，各還本位。東弗于逮過水睹影，打失布袋；西瞿耶尼倒腹傾腸；北鬱單越打破大唐國，覓起處不得；南贍部洲相呼相喚云：『歸去好珍重，後園驢喫草。』雖然，人無遠慮，必有近憂，其奈笑破土地鼻孔。昨來重九之期，村歌社舞無處作賽，望空啟告云：『何緣得到與麼地？』秪恐山中人目斷雲山，不惜草鞋，一為舉似俊鷹快鷂，一任分髓分皮。苟或眼目定動，莫怪璣上座不近人情好。」「父母未生，洞見百骸五內；形名未兆，達乎此界他方。日照天臨，因甚隔山人唱鷓鴣詞，錯認胡笳十八拍？春風如刀，春雨如膏，生殺互作，律令不饒。昨日百花芳妍，今日滿地殘紅，任他梅魁多士、柳逞風流，葉脫香飄，一場狼籍，要終原始，斯皆我老。胡不唧溜？一枝纔動，百枝撼搖。遂有漢語胡言：一花開五葉，結果自然成。令一隊無巴鼻漢，於花果上別香別味，形影參差。璣上座今日不管他栴檀栗棘、碩果薝蔔，一時投向烈焰中，匪圖輝天鑑地，秪欲粉骨碎身。東山門下還有入水不溺、入火不燒者，出來添膏續焰。」「向上一路，凡聖共由。不得踏著，踏著則草木成兵，壁立千仞，人天罔措；不得住著，住著則髑髏前見鬼，百尺竿頭進步，旋轉乾坤；不得

ClaimAnchors.Kwic: 年前生也本不曾生，二十年後滅也本不曾滅，既無生又無滅，則盡十方剎土若淨若穢，一任隨緣放曠、任性逍遙，慶雲拂子不妨為你證據。且道證據箇甚麼？更聽一偈：有相身中無相身，纖塵不染絕疏親，當人若解回頭看，剎剎無非是要津。」師到七里菴，大霖主規率眾檀越請小參。「者一片田地，自有祖以來便結契與諸人了也。若是箇善承紹底，一切時中不惟家歌樂業，亦且戶慶安居，縱饒僭竊公行，亦復不敢睥睨。諸人要識這箇來歷麼？」驀以拂子打圓相，云：「此是從上佛祖相傳的契券，任是智如鶖子，智不能知；辯似滿慈，辯不能悉。唯許上無攀仰、下絕己躬底衲僧一肩擔荷，始堪克振嘉聲，為當家種草。且道目前誰是其人？」乃豎拂子，云：「面目現在。」雨山和尚語錄卷第三雨山和尚語錄卷第四嗣法門人記住龍舒白雲禪院語住龍舒白雲禪院語子待上座四十誕辰，請小參。「冷落門戶，獨推風穴；破落門戶，還遜楊岐。東鼓門戶，冷則夜燃松脂，破則床盈雪霰，蓋真有二老風味也。所以，山僧自踏足此間，有椎不拈、有拂不豎，一日打眠三五度，也消不得許多閒。奈有箇無事尋事做底，朝和南、暮不審，欲求一言以永壽命，山僧推托不過，只得扯箇古話以塞其白。記得魯國老孔有云：『知者樂水，仁者樂山；知者動，仁者靜。』拋卻城隍古寺，來空閒寂寞之濱，不可不謂之靜。者既靜矣，且道：仁者壽量又何如演說？」驀豎起拂子，云：「看，看！秪者箇歷千劫而不古，任他白鼠推遷，要且銀臺不變。山僧恁麼舉揚，還稱諸上座意也無？」良久，云：「遇明眼人，一任舉似。」端午，師誕日祈雨，羽公蔣居士請小參。「山僧自到龍舒口邊，實情掃得白醭出，提著佛法兩字，如生冤家相似，非故不近人情，蓋從上風規應如是也。記得長沙岑和尚有云：『我若一向舉揚宗教，法堂前須草深一丈。』爾等既稱祖師門下客，何不略自回眸，看看先宗是何標格？真實向你道：若心地未明、智眼未開，切忌求佛、求祖、求心性、求玄妙，以當平生。設使求而得之，皆屬所依，譬如水母以蝦為目，無有自由分。試看天地未分、未有生佛名字以前一著，你還馳求得麼？你還依傍得麼？既馳求、依傍他不得，到這裏直饒智如鶖子、辯似滿慈，尚未彷彿其趨向，何況今時望道未見者妄自承當，一味露布葛藤以稱得旨？何殊平人妄稱帝王，自取誅戮？奉勸兄弟：既在此箇門中，參須徹、悟須透，莫秪向門頭戶口掠些光影，便為得本。如此見解

Senses.Explanation: One moon appears in many waters without dividing into separate moons; the reflections are gathered by that one moon. Fangrong lifts a mooncake and points from the sky to the water before denying that reasoning alone reaches the image. Hansong sets many viewers under one autumn moon. Xueyan explains the image through one mind and many phenomena, then asks after the moon when clouds intervene. Chushi asks which is moon and which is water when the whole earth is each. Baiyun raises a staff and tests whether listeners can use the image in practice.

Senses.PreferredTarget: many kinds within one and no division within two
AlternateTargets: one is manifold while two remain undivided

Senses.PreferredTarget: Once authority is in hand, watch how the command is carried out.
AlternateTargets: Once authority is in hand, watch how the command is carried out.

Occurrences.Kwic: 寒暑到來，如何迴避？洞山云：何不向無寒暑處去？僧云：如何是無寒暑處？洞山云：寒時寒殺闍梨，熱時熱殺闍梨。洞山百味具足，後來又合如何？忽有人問圓通：如何是無寒暑處？劈脊便棒。參！上堂，云：未得箇入頭處，須得箇入頭處；既得箇入頭處，不得辜負老僧。大眾！睦州老兒可謂經事多矣，要坐便坐，要行便行。然雖如是，天無全功。上堂，僧問：如何是奪人不奪境？師云：退身三步。如何是奪境不奪人？師云：一朝權在手，看取令行時。如何是人境兩俱奪？師云：拄杖頭折。如何是人境俱不奪？師云：家家觀世音。僧問：牛頭未見四祖時，為什麼百鳥㘅花献？師云：世情看冷暖。僧云：見後為什麼百鳥不㘅花献？師云：人面逐高低。乃云：若立一塵，家國興盛，野老嚬蹙；若不立一塵，家國喪亡，野老安貼。大眾且道：立即是？不立即是？良久，云：心不負人，面無慚色。以手拍禪床一下，云：參。下座。上堂，云：心隨萬境轉，轉處實能幽。大眾！山河大

Occurrences.Kwic: 興眼無筋，錯中南方蠱毒深，一掬肝膓俱裂破，年年此日痛傷心。謝新舊兩班，上堂。欲建大廈，須假眾材；欲駕巨舟，必資眾手。眾材既辨，大廈可成；眾手能為，巨舟必濟。山野濫尸祖席，曲荷諸人相成，老慧超法令如存，南禪師愿力猶在。到這裏，其進也，獰龍得水；其退也，猛虎靠山。何親？何踈？無新？無舊？萬事頭頭合轍，一門和氣藹然，前三後三，日面月面。然雖如是，且道：不動干戈，坐致太平一句又作麼生？一朝權在手，看取令行時。因事，上堂。是非長短耳邊風，切莫於中覔異同。要得八風吹不動，放教心地等虗空。慈受老人只解順水張帆，不能逆風把柂。黃龍又且不然，是非都去了，是非裏薦取。何故聻？幾度黑風翻大浪，未曾聞道釣舟傾。上堂，舉：雲門示眾云：十五日已前即不問，十五日已後道將一句來。自代云：日日是好日。師云：這跛脚阿師，始者與麼告報將謂將謂，及乎末後露出尾巴元來元來。黃龍即不然，十五日已前即不問，十五日已後
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (X/X69/X69n1355.xml). 無門慧開禪師語錄. Wumen Huikai uses the full line to conclude a hall address on bringing about peace without weapons.

Occurrences.Kwic: 家。師云：二老漢當時若踏著臨濟向上底，我等今日飯也無喫，還知薦福落處麼？驀拈拄杖，卓一卓，喝一喝，下座。上堂，僧問：臨濟有四賓主話，如何是賓中賓？師云：滿眼是埃塵。進云：如何是主中賓？師云：腦後薦取。進云：如何是賓中主？師云：東行不見西行利。進云：如何是主中主？師云：脚下泥深三尺。師乃云：大通智勝佛，十劫坐道場，佛法不現前，不得成佛道。衲僧門下却較些子，且和泥合水一句作麼生道？一朝權在手，看取令行時。上堂，舉：僧問玄沙：如何是學人自己？沙云：是你自己。雲門云：沒量大人向語脉裏轉却。時有僧問：如何是學人自己？門云：忽有人路上請老僧齋，你也隨例得飯喫。師云：玄沙只有殺人刀，且無活人劒；雲門雖有活人劒，且無殺人刀。雖然，二俱不了，落在薦福手裏。且如何折合？驀拈拄杖，卓一卓，云：輸賦王租了，皷腹唱謳歌。上堂，舉：僧問法眼：如何是曹源一滴水？法眼云：是曹源一滴水。師云：法眼恁麼說話

ClaimAnchors.Kwic: 興眼無筋，錯中南方蠱毒深，一掬肝膓俱裂破，年年此日痛傷心。謝新舊兩班，上堂。欲建大廈，須假眾材；欲駕巨舟，必資眾手。眾材既辨，大廈可成；眾手能為，巨舟必濟。山野濫尸祖席，曲荷諸人相成，老慧超法令如存，南禪師愿力猶在。到這裏，其進也，獰龍得水；其退也，猛虎靠山。何親？何踈？無新？無舊？萬事頭頭合轍，一門和氣藹然，前三後三，日面月面。然雖如是，且道：不動干戈，坐致太平一句又作麼生？一朝權在手，看取令行時。因事，上堂。是非長短耳邊風，切莫於中覔異同。要得八風吹不動，放教心地等虗空。慈受老人只解順水張帆，不能逆風把柂。黃龍又且不然，是非都去了，是非裏薦取。何故聻？幾度黑風翻大浪，未曾聞道釣舟傾。上堂，舉：雲門示眾云：十五日已前即不問，十五日已後道將一句來。自代云：日日是好日。師云：這跛脚阿師，始者與麼告報將謂將謂，及乎末後露出尾巴元來元來。黃龍即不然，十五日已前即不問，十五日已後

Senses.Explanation: One blow leaves one welt; one slap draws a handful of blood. Demand a decisive, palpable effect from Chan action or speech. Miyun Yuanwu and Liangting Jingting use the complete saying in distinct recorded teaching turns. Poshan Haiming, Feiyin Tongrong, and Shitian Faxun give further current deployments. The blows are an image of unmistakable effect, not a mandate for physical violence.

Senses.PreferredTarget: kill with one blow
SearchAliases: kill outright in a single blow
Senses.Note: The fixed phrase names killing by a single blow; the final noun is counted as the blow-as-act in this construction, not separately described as a staff object. Baoben Facun uses it as a direct threat, while the other retained cases quote or question Yunmen Wenyan’s threat.

Senses.Explanation: Kill with one blow is a fixed threat or described action of striking someone dead in one blow. Senses.PreferredTarget: Cast from one mold
Senses.Note: “Cast from one mold” means the products have a common shape. Luyan says it when three students offer different words that all miss the moon; Sanyi says it of repeated explanations that leave the old case untouched. Baichi gives the same image a positive force for lineage continuity, and Guxue does likewise for a transmitted seal. Yunwai uses it after striking the table, while Jiqi writes of the nose born with one’s face. The surrounding turn decides whether sameness is a virtue or a defect.

Senses.Explanation: A single responsive device and a single encountered configuration in Chan teaching. The pair commonly stands beside one word, one phrase, one blow, or one shout as a deliberately provisional opening for a student. Yuanwu Keqin groups one device and one situation with one word and one phrase, warning that each seeks an entry but can cut a wound in good flesh. Guting Shanjian contrasts ancient teachers whose single word, silence, device, or situation overturned students with contemporary laxity. Shiyu Mingfang rejects dependence on one device and one situation at entry, demanding an immediate presentation. Zhongfeng Mingben reports an objection that lamp records show adepts becoming free and clear through a single device or situation. Hanyue Fazang says that one device and one situation cannot be entered by pushing, placing the formula against the three mysteries and three essentials.

Senses.PreferredTarget: where does the one return?
AlternateTargets: where does the one go back to?
to where does the one return?
SearchAliases: where does the one go back
ten thousand things return to one
Senses.Explanation: This is the stock second half of the question 'the ten thousand things return to one; where does the one return?' The first half supplies the otherwise missing antecedent of 'the one.' An unnamed monk puts the complete question to Zhaozhou Congshen, who answers that in Qingzhou he made a cloth shirt weighing seven catties. The question is not confined to that exchange: Hongzhi Zhengjue places beside it a version answered by Wenshu Yingzhen with 'the Yellow River's nine bends,' and Baizhang Mingzhao An answers that not one person has failed to ask. Gaofeng Yuanmiao makes the question his entire address before looking left and right and leaving the seat; Lanan Dingxu uses it as a chamber test; Zhuquan Liaohuan Falin supplies another answer. Zen bends an ordinary destination question into a portable public-interview challenge whose divergent answers are the history of one stable question, not different meanings of the headword.
Senses.Note: Across the collected corpus the exact question occurs 838 times in 216 texts; the full two-part question is also extensively attested with and without punctuation. No equation-style self-definition was found. Multiple respondents, answers, later comments, an entire hall address, a chamber test, and continuous use as an assigned saying all preserve one question rather than an individual-specific meaning.

Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (J/J39/J39nB448.xml). Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Lingji. Lingji Xingguan owns the retained deployment, ordering the sky-covering, earth-bearing stretch of light squeezed out until it streams from the chest.

Senses.Explanation: The mind's inborn luminity counted as one whole stretch, shining before birth and waiting to be reclaimed from ink and clamor. Zhufeng Zhenxu, on the ghost festival, sets autumn-pool moon-shadow and still-night bell-sound around one stretch of light that never dulls, and warns that whoever only half-grasps it is a dead man whose soul has not scattered; Hongzhi Zhengjue hangs the bright moon of a frost sky over the central peak and lets one stretch of light wash the dull darkness; Yezhu Fuhui, tonsuring the layman Chen Qin, takes up the upward hammer to spark the stretch of light behind that newly shaven head; and Qibai Defu, in xiaocan, declares the stretch shone on heaven before leaving the womb and lights the earth after, endowed in everyone, undimmed in the fool, unincreased in the sage. Ruibai Mingxue, writing to the layman Zhang Wofu, rules that with no second person or second thought to be found it is only one's own one stretch of light — set your eyes there and stop seeking outward; Shanhui Huan, recounting his own years in the lecture halls, groans that the stretch of light of the buddhas and ancestors was buried under ink and letters; Baiyu Jingsi, at the news of Yongjue's death, watches the old man's final stretch of light shoot three thousand miles into Yusi peak; and Lingji Xingguan, answering the scholar Zhu, orders him to squeeze out at full speed the sky-covering, earth-bearing stretch of light until it streams from his chest.

Senses.PreferredTarget: If even one thing is fixed, Vairocana falls among ordinary people; if all things are absent, Samantabhadra loses his field
SearchAliases: if even one thing is fixed, vairocana falls among ordinary people; if all things are absent, samantabhadra loses his field
Senses.Note: The saying says that holding to one fixed thing lowers Vairocana, while declaring all things absent leaves Samantabhadra without a field. Poshan gives the pair after questions from his assembly; Zhangxue adds a hand gesture to test what is meant by one. Hanyu tells listeners to cut off the two sides, and Minshu follows the pair through a sermon on forms of present activity. The two halves work together as a refusal to settle in either position.

Senses.Explanation: One stick of incense is a counted offering used in formal dedications, blessings, memorials, and, in some records, as the duration of an act. A later Linji-line master dedicates one stick to his teacher Linji, while Yulin’s ceremony offers separate sticks for the Three Treasures, the empress dowager, and the emperor. Huanyou Chuan names a wider field of recipients, and later memorial scenes burn one stick before the named predecessor’s stupa. These are corpus-wide ceremonial uses, not a Linji-only expression. Where a source uses the burning of one stick as elapsed time, the counted object remains the same but its grammatical role is temporal.

Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (J/J36/J36nB369.xml). Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Zhe’an Fan. Zhe'an Jingfan owns the retained deployment, telling the assembly everyone has this field, undamaged through every season, so no bounds need redrawing.

Senses.Explanation: A measured metaphor unit naming the inherited endowment as one whole field, handed over long ago and left open for all to till. Xuefeng Yicun, recorded in his disciple's extensive log, declares the matter like one whole stretch of field left for everyone to till, with none who fail to owe it strength; Xuansha Shibei, preserved in Dahui's old-case verses, deeds away the field's four borders to all while keeping only the center tree for the old monk; and Huitang Zuxin laments heirs who let the handed-down field run to brambles while chasing daily grain, telling them to claim the original deed with its borders plain. Yuanwu Keqin runs his hall address through false takes at the staff's head and the shout below before landing on the field handed over long ago and plain deceit; Dahui Zonggao holds that one who knows where this whole field lands cannot be moved a hair by birth and death; Buhui Fatong answers the elders' chain by refusing any re-deed, since the field needs no handing over and the four directions are nowhere else; Juelang Daosheng judges the Xuefeng and Xuansha pair as leaving the field mutually abandoned and answers the asking with a staff; and Zhe'an Jingfan tells the assembly everyone has this field, which no season has ever dared damage, so why redraw its bounds.

Senses.PreferredTarget: This field was entrusted to you long ago
SearchAliases: this field was entrusted to you long ago
Senses.Note: An old teacher says the field has been entrusted for a long time and waits for the listener to reach it. Later masters question that waiting. Baichi calls three elders overly solicitous; Liao’an says standing, sitting, and ceremonial repentance all miss the time. Tian’an offers thirty blows whether the listener reaches it or not. Tianyin asks why an already entrusted field must still be reached; Buhui says it needs no transfer. Yezhu strikes the table and says the field has long been given. The image presses the gap between possession and recognition.

Senses.Explanation: The old image says a field was entrusted long ago, then asks why its holder is still trying to reach it. Senses.Explanation: Luopu Yuanan answers a question about feeding many buddhas versus feeding one who has neither cultivation nor realization with a valley scene: a bank of white cloud closes the mouth, and returning birds lose their nests at night. The Jingde Lamp Record preserves Luopu's answer directly. Yuanwu Keqin quotes it in the Blue Cliff Record and rejects treating such an answer as casual speech; he presents an old master's situation and utterance as a device that can hold fast or release. Hongzhi Zhengjue raises the exchange and comments on it, while Tianyin Yuanxiu and Gaofeng Yuanmiao use variants of the line to close their own public statements. The saying therefore lives in the corpus as more than a lamp-record relic.

Senses.Explanation: A white cloud closes the valley mouth, and returning birds lose the way to their nests. Tianyin gives the line after asking whether two older teachers’ words have been understood. Yongji makes it the end of a verse in a present challenge. Falan reads a letter and responds with the couplet. Shenfeng gives it as a direct reply to a monk. The older Luopu answer remains an inherited family, not an additional current speaker.

Senses.PreferredTarget: A patch of white cloud stretches across the valley mouth; many returning birds lose sight of their nests
AlternateTargets: White cloud blocks the valley entrance and the homeward birds lose their way to the nest

Senses.Note: A white cloud lies across the mouth of a valley; birds returning to their nests lose their bearings. Fushi offers the scene as his answer to an inquiry about the route. Zixian and Feiyin make it a question about what is happening now, while Baichi, Hanxiu, and Gaofeng redeploy it in their own sermons. The cloud matters because it makes a familiar way home hard to find.

Occurrences.Kwic: 即今香花羅列，清供滿前，且道我涵兄和尚還來攝受否？若道不受，卻成虛設；若道攝受，蒸嘗現住，畢竟如何即得？」以拂子點云：「夜深不向蘆灣宿，迥出中間與兩頭。」靜持禪德設齋，請上堂。僧問：「處處綠楊堪繫馬，為甚麼有佛處不得住？」師云：「棒打石人頭。」進云：「家家門首透長安，為甚麼無佛處急走過？」師云：「嚗嚗論實事。」進云：「學人不會，乞師指示。」師云：「東海東畔是新羅。」進云：「若不得流水，還應過別山。」師云：「沼祖來也。」僧禮拜。乃云：「杲日當天，光輝萬象，璿璣運轉天關，金鰲統該地軸。空中木馬，長淅瀝以嘶風；海底泥牛，時滂湃以駕浪。吞月蝦蟆居井底，抱兒石虎臥岩前。於斯明得向上一路別有家風，格外提持，靈機迥異。且作麼是向上一路？還委悉麼？古殿西風寒颯颯，一聲鴻唯過遼天。」解制，上堂。僧問：「師未陞座時，還有佛法也無？」師云：「有。」進云：「如何是未陞座時佛法？」師云：「高低古柏沿山翠，長短幽篁滿澗青。」進云：「陞座後又如何？」師云：「一片白雲橫谷口，幾多歸鳥自迷巢。」問：「學人得得到五臺，因甚麼不見文殊？」師云：「望嵩樓畔陽人聚。」進云：「學人不會，請師直指。」師云：「此去汝州不遠。」僧禮拜。乃云：「一向把住，今日放行。其把住也，壁立萬仞，水泄不通，白雲寺裏高掛缽囊，眉毛廝結，一箇箇掃蹤絕跡，直至千江浪息，大地平沉；其放行也，陽和氣轉，暖律初回，風穴山中橫擔拄杖，緊峭草鞋，一箇箇放光動地，只得冰河發燄，枯木生花。正恁麼時，還是把住好？放行好？且隨老木同寒瘠，將逐春風入燒瘢。」金粟虎堂和尚專使至，請上堂。僧問：「世尊雪山睹明星大悟，又悟箇甚麼？」師云：「鼻孔大頭垂。」進云：「分明成現事，何用受辛勤？」師云：「若不如是，焉知如是？」進云：「只如殃崛救產，還是佛法靈驗？還是果熟自落？」師云：「佛法靈驗，果熟自落。」進云：「古人不見今時月，今月曾經照古人。」師云：「引不著。」僧禮拜，師云：「切忌躲跟。」乃云：「連枝同氣，共闡向上宗猷；正令全提，各自隨機應變。灑汝海之一雨，萬卉欣榮；繼金粟之遺蹤，真燈昺耀。光揚先師法道，提獎後進弟昆，在吾金粟虎兄堂頭和尚矣，不任歡慶。似僕無識之夫，謬主斯席，恒愧素餐，何期實念松麓二上座遠從金粟、深入白雲，得得遠馳書幣來此設齋，仍請陞座為眾舉揚向上宗乘，過沐周勤

ClaimAnchors.Kwic: 夫漢個個眼似銅鈴，想必不居人後。雖然，忽有問妙高峰頂事，又作麼生抵對？莫是落霞與孤鶩齊飛，秋水共長天一色麼？莫是昭昭於心目之間而相不可睹，晃晃於色塵之內而理不可分麼？若與麼抵對，猶屬半途，未識妙高峰頂事在。畢竟如何？極力為君說不得，到頭自肯迺方親。」復卓拄杖，下座。上堂。「拈花微笑，誑謼人天；面壁安心，無瘡剜肉；黃梅夜渡，自惹災殃；南嶽磨磚，猢猻伎倆。直饒入門便棒，猶是皮袋裏藏身；見僧便喝，總在聲塵中出沒。其餘談玄嚼妙、豎教明宗，如竹葦稻麻，何足掛齒？寶峰門下無道可學、無禪可參，一切隨緣，坐消歲月，任他諸方鬧浩浩，我只白眼踞青松。眾中或有知機識變底，自然不相辜負；脫若依前作解，把纜放船，爭怪得山僧？」同薦親，請上堂。「塵世乾坤窄，蓬壺日月長，乘緣能擺脫，舉步到家鄉。家鄉既到，則無生死之名，亦無垢淨之相，凝然湛寂，不動不搖，過去諸佛、現在諸佛、未來諸佛盡在箇裏交光相羅，如寶絲網。政恁麼時，且道：馬、李二姓嚴慈還見麼？若然弗見，可謂一片白雲橫谷口，幾多歸鳥自迷巢，元上座不免借般若力，為伊點破去。」遂豎拂，云：「秪這是，莫沉吟，人人勢至，個個觀音，當陽一句沒攔蓋，雨過夜塘秋水深。」復擊香几，下座。上堂。「聞名不如見面，遠親不如近鄰，冷地忽來添炭，思量真箇可人。無盡意菩薩於百草頭上化度有情，偶觸著山僧拄杖子，亦相與合掌讚揚，歎未曾有。且畢竟讚揚箇什麼？近日生菜兩文一斤，白米九分一斗，各自宜爾室家，莫管前前後後。所以道：榮辱常隨騎馬客，是非弗到釣魚翁。汝等今日還肯如是說也無？」拍膝一下，云：「龍蛇易辨，衲子難瞞。」退院，上堂。「『世人住處我不住，世人行處我不行，不是與人難共住，大都緇素要分明』，古德恁麼道，可謂孤迥迥、峭巍巍，千古莫並其風。山僧此者則不然，世人住處我已住，世人行處我已行，而今緣盡開交也，笑指前途螺髻青。倘有不肯底出來道：『和尚便恁麼去那？』秪向他道：『我為法王，於法自在。』」到九僊獅子窟，上堂。「獅巖路近九僊家，古柏如虯絢彩霞，乘興攀藤窮絕頂，天風吹落杖頭花。大眾！那箇是杖頭花？試揀擇出來看。」良久，云：「荒草紆蔓人不見，淒淒歸路夕陽斜。」到雲居，上堂。僧問：「雲居山頂一輪月，未審何年照何人？」師云：「今古應無墜，分明在目前。」進云：「學人已知，為什麼舉頭不見？」師云：「

ClaimAnchors.Kwic: 即今香花羅列，清供滿前，且道我涵兄和尚還來攝受否？若道不受，卻成虛設；若道攝受，蒸嘗現住，畢竟如何即得？」以拂子點云：「夜深不向蘆灣宿，迥出中間與兩頭。」靜持禪德設齋，請上堂。僧問：「處處綠楊堪繫馬，為甚麼有佛處不得住？」師云：「棒打石人頭。」進云：「家家門首透長安，為甚麼無佛處急走過？」師云：「嚗嚗論實事。」進云：「學人不會，乞師指示。」師云：「東海東畔是新羅。」進云：「若不得流水，還應過別山。」師云：「沼祖來也。」僧禮拜。乃云：「杲日當天，光輝萬象，璿璣運轉天關，金鰲統該地軸。空中木馬，長淅瀝以嘶風；海底泥牛，時滂湃以駕浪。吞月蝦蟆居井底，抱兒石虎臥岩前。於斯明得向上一路別有家風，格外提持，靈機迥異。且作麼是向上一路？還委悉麼？古殿西風寒颯颯，一聲鴻唯過遼天。」解制，上堂。僧問：「師未陞座時，還有佛法也無？」師云：「有。」進云：「如何是未陞座時佛法？」師云：「高低古柏沿山翠，長短幽篁滿澗青。」進云：「陞座後又如何？」師云：「一片白雲橫谷口，幾多歸鳥自迷巢。」問：「學人得得到五臺，因甚麼不見文殊？」師云：「望嵩樓畔陽人聚。」進云：「學人不會，請師直指。」師云：「此去汝州不遠。」僧禮拜。乃云：「一向把住，今日放行。其把住也，壁立萬仞，水泄不通，白雲寺裏高掛缽囊，眉毛廝結，一箇箇掃蹤絕跡，直至千江浪息，大地平沉；其放行也，陽和氣轉，暖律初回，風穴山中橫擔拄杖，緊峭草鞋，一箇箇放光動地，只得冰河發燄，枯木生花。正恁麼時，還是把住好？放行好？且隨老木同寒瘠，將逐春風入燒瘢。」金粟虎堂和尚專使至，請上堂。僧問：「世尊雪山睹明星大悟，又悟箇甚麼？」師云：「鼻孔大頭垂。」進云：「分明成現事，何用受辛勤？」師云：「若不如是，焉知如是？」進云：「只如殃崛救產，還是佛法靈驗？還是果熟自落？」師云：「佛法靈驗，果熟自落。」進云：「古人不見今時月，今月曾經照古人。」師云：「引不著。」僧禮拜，師云：「切忌躲跟。」乃云：「連枝同氣，共闡向上宗猷；正令全提，各自隨機應變。灑汝海之一雨，萬卉欣榮；繼金粟之遺蹤，真燈昺耀。光揚先師法道，提獎後進弟昆，在吾金粟虎兄堂頭和尚矣，不任歡慶。似僕無識之夫，謬主斯席，恒愧素餐，何期實念松麓二上座遠從金粟、深入白雲，得得遠馳書幣來此設齋，仍請陞座為眾舉揚向上宗乘，過沐周勤

ClaimAnchors.Kwic: 光影如駒過隙，直須如救頭然，切莫隨情放逸。卓拄杖，云：夜來一雨雪消鎔，萬疊青山如洗出。元宵，上堂。參禪須是鐵漢，著手心頭便判。只如雪覆千山，孤峰不白，作麼生判？擲拄杖，云：上元定是正月半。上堂，舉：百丈和尚問溈山云：併却咽喉唇吻，道將一句來。山云：却請和尚道。師拈云：大小溈山推惡離己，今日忽有人問西峰：併却咽喉唇吻，道將一句來。即向他道：柴荒米貴，忍飢無暇。祗對。佛涅槃，上堂：周行七步猶成跡，槨示雙趺豈易收？微雨灑花千點泪，淡烟籠竹一堆愁。晚參。身貧道貧，無法可親，一味盲枷瞎棒，聞者見者莫不生嗔。卓拄杖，云：黃金自有黃金價，終不和沙賣與人。結制，上堂。西峰今年結夏，全然不成保社。一日兩頭薄粥，大家忍飢無暇。雖有真如佛性、菩提涅槃，和聲擲拄杖，云：權且颺在師子巖下。上堂。終日著衣，未甞挂一縷絲；終日喫飯，未甞咬一粒米。既然如是，且道即今身上著底、每日口裏喫底是箇甚麼？到遮裏，不論明與不明、徹與不徹，寸絲滴水也當牽犂拽杷償他。何故？一片白雲橫谷口，幾多歸鳥自迷巢。上堂。若論此事，只要當人的有切心。纔有切心，真疑便起。真疑起時，不屬漸次。直下便能塵勞頓息，昏散屏除。一念不生，前後際斷。纔到遮般時節，管取推門落臼。若是此念不切，真疑不起，饒你坐破蒲團百千萬箇，依舊日午打三更。上堂：迷中有悟，悟復還迷。直須迷悟兩忘，人法俱遣，衲僧門下始有語話分。大眾，既是迷悟兩忘，人法俱遣，共語話者復是阿誰？速道！速道！上堂：諸方拈槌豎拂，接物利生，祇解指虗空說虗空，指燈籠露柱說燈籠露柱。於是藥頭無驗，誤人多矣。西峰要向未有虗空名字以前說虗空，未有燈籠露柱以前說燈籠露柱，要使聞者見者，𡎺著磕著，一得永得，一證永證。大眾，未有名字以前，畢竟憑何施設？以拂子擊禪牀一下，又連擊兩下。上堂。日正暄，春已暮，落花片片隨流去。拈拄杖，云：拄杖枝頭一點紅，馨香徧界無人顧。大眾！顧不顧即且止，畢竟一歸何處？擲拄杖，下座。解制，上堂。一夏以來，諸人懡㦬，山僧亦懡㦬，懡㦬逢懡㦬，彼此無空過。今朝聖制告圓，不免更說些懡㦬禪，嬴得大家俱懡㦬。如何是懡㦬禪？咄！猛火著油煎。除夜，小參。一年三百六十日，看看逗到今宵畢，十箇有五雙，參禪禪又不知、學道道亦不識，只遮不知不識四字正是三世諸佛骨髓、一大藏教根源，伶俐漢纔聞舉著，如龍得水、

Senses.Explanation: A cloud closes the valley mouth and returning birds lose their nests. Fushi and Zixian use the obstructed route to correct older or competing answers. Feiyin, Baichi, Hanxiu, and Gaofeng make the same landscape a present teaching question.

Entries.SourceTerm: 一片白雲橫谷口，許多歸鳥盡迷巢

Senses.PreferredTarget: A white cloud stretches across the valley mouth; many returning birds lose the way to their nests.
AlternateTargets: One white cloud bars the valley entrance, and the homeward birds all miss their nests.
SearchAliases: white cloud valley entrance returning birds lost nests Chan
cloud across valley birds miss home Zen
Senses.Note: Yunfu, Shanyi, and Yanju each use the full pair after pressing the assembly to recognize a present answer; Buyan inserts it as his own comment at the turning point of a Deshan case. The first image closes a route, and the second shows the cost in birds returning home. The saying is used to warn of a missed opening, rather than to describe a named valley or monastery.

Senses.Explanation: One thing leaves the thing unnamed; speakers propose it, deny it, ask for it, or reject the adequacy of calling it a thing. Nanyue Huairang tells Huineng that describing it as one thing would miss it. Huineng's verse says that originally there is not one thing. An unnamed monk asks what the one thing that remains numinous is, and Wuxiang says no external thing establishes anything. Shiguan Fazang challenges anyone who does not rely on one thing to come forward; Dongshan Liangjie is quoted as saying there is one thing black as lacquer; Manjushri says there is not one thing there to distinguish; Huanyou Zhengchuan asks how one thing could pass beyond the circle's center; and Jiashan Ziling asks who says there is no one thing.

Senses.PreferredTarget: If I bring nothing, what am I to put down?
SearchAliases: if i bring nothing, what am i to put down?
Senses.Note: Yanyang asks what to do when he has brought nothing. Zhaozhou tells him to put it down, and Yanyang asks, “If I bring nothing, what am I to put down?” Zhaozhou’s next turn sends him off carrying what he cannot put down. Tiebi uses the exchange to warn students against clinging to the idea that they already carry nothing. Yezhu tells his student to inspect Zhaozhou’s reply. Zhe’an pictures a poor household taking on another load; Gaofeng pictures the pull of a hook that continues after a seeming release. The question exposes the attachment hidden in a claim of emptiness.

Senses.Explanation: One offering of incense is a portion presented or burned for a stated recipient or purpose. Guo Xiangzheng offers one to Wuzu Fayan during a requested hall address, and Juelang Daosheng offers separate portions to ancestral teachers. Hansong Zhicao and Foyan Qingyuan present offerings for the emperor; Baiyu Jingsi and Ruibai Mingxue name officials, nobles, local officers, and patrons. Feiyin Tongrong's “watch this offering burn” shows that the phrase still names the offering when the recipient is supplied only by the wider ceremony. A teacher may receive it in thanks for the dharma, but the phrase alone does not assert lineage transmission.

Senses.Explanation: A small plot is crowded with three snakes and nine rats. Baochi Xuanzong, Muyun Tongmen, Jinian Jingxian, and Baichi Xingyuan deploy the fixed count as an answer, a capping line, or a concentrated image of troublesome multiplicity. The acre supplies one bounded ground while the snakes and rats multiply within it. Jinian uses the line as the answer to the great meaning; Muyun offers it as a demanded saying; Baichi expands it with noses connected and eyebrows joined.

Senses.PreferredTarget: Each time it is raised, it is new again
SearchAliases: each time it is raised, it is new again
Senses.Note: The phrase joins repetition to newness. Yuanan says it when a monk has requested teaching more than once. Yinyuan raises incense and calls the act new again. Yikui answers a monk who asks why old teaching is spoken anew. Jieweizhou says it while hanging a monastery board; Miaoyun gives it as a direct answer when the canon is opened once more. In each turn the same words or gesture become a present event requiring recognition.

Senses.Explanation: One blind person leading many blind people is an unseeing guide drawing followers into the same danger. Yulin Tongxiu, Miyun Yuanwu, Dufeng Benshan, and Daxiu Zhu all complete the image with the blind group being led into a fire pit. Their targets differ—licensed conduct, failure to answer, counterfeit teachers, and untested imitation—but the use is stable: someone without the required sight claims authority and multiplies the error publicly. Tian'an Sheng and Shunde use the same line while appraising inherited cases, so the phrase is a verdict on transmission without seeing.

Occurrences.Kwic: 道：大用現前，不存軌則時如何？便與和聲一踏，待佗眼孔定動，老僧已入大石國裏去也。白頭因見韶山，山云：莫是多口白頭因麼？師云：白頭因口雖多，爭奈開了合不得？合了開不得，返不奈箇無口底何？徑山當時若見佗問：莫是多口白頭因麼？只向他道：這老賊前後觸忤多少賢良。以坐具便摵，直饒韶山手中有棒，亦無施展處。僧問：曹山抱璞投師，請師雕琢。師云：曹山雖不損花而得蜜，亦未免費口分疎。山僧即不然，或有人問：抱璞投師，請師雕琢。只向佗道：明朝更獻楚王看。稅闍梨問：曹山清稅孤貧，乞師賑濟。師云：老曹山雖則眼目睛明，爭奈放過稅闍梨？若是育王則不然，當時待佗恁麼問，拈起拄杖劈脊便打。何故？禮防君子。曹山辭洞山，洞山云：子向什麼處去？曹山云：不變異處去。洞山云：不變異處，豈有去耶？曹山云：去亦不變異。師云：好大眾！田地穩密，血脉貫通即不無，曹洞父子檢點將來，俗氣猶在。洞山萬里，無寸草處去。師云：二大老，一人下脚不得，一人擡脚不起，有人辨得，許你東去西去。洞山一盲引眾盲，相牽入火坑。石霜雖盡力𨁝跳，要且跳不出。鄮峰則不然，秋初夏末，兄弟東去西去，第一不得向萬里無寸草處去。何故？長安雖樂，不是久居。洞山雖則布漫天網，撈蝦蜆摝即得，若要羅龍打鳳則不可。後來石霜道：出門便是草。果然。臘月二十五師云：這公案往往多作奇特話會，便道雲門一曲韻出五音，殊不知這老漢等閑放屁，合著大石調。僧問雲門：秋初夏末，東去西去，忽有人問著，作麼生祗對？雲門云：退後，退後。僧云：某甲有什麼過？門云：還我九十日飯錢來。師云：雲門先鋒有作，殿後併吞，是則是，要且無大人相。徑山則不然，待佗道：某甲有什麼過？只向佗道：此去逢人但恁麼舉。雲門問僧：甚處來？僧云：嶽山來。門云：我尋常不曾與人葛藤來。僧近前。門云：去。師云：葛藤不少。僧問雲門：如何是直截一路？門云：主山後。僧云：謝師指示。門云：合取皮袋。師云：雲門大師是則是，直截未免飜成紆曲。徑山不然。或問：如何是直截一路？案：山前若言謝師指示，只向道：一任東行西行。雲門問僧：什麼處來？僧云：江西。門云：江西一隊老漢𥧌語住也未？僧無對。師乃云：噫！可惜許，好與劈口摑。當時既已放過，至今𥧌語未已。喝一喝。雲門放洞山三頓棒。師云：雲門前頭疑殺人，後頭笑殺人，洞山於言下悟去，更是好笑。如今莫有解笑底

Occurrences.Kwic: 趣中王，一念回光，即得解脫。是故古德云：破戒受罪，終登解脫之場；不受不破，永墮泥犁之苦。瓔珞經云：若一切眾生，不受菩薩戒者，不名有情、識者、畜生無異，不名為人，常離三寶海，名為邪見，名為外道。智論云：譬如無足欲行，無翅欲飛，無船欲渡，是不可得。若無淨戒，欲求妙果，亦復如是。若人棄捨此戒，雖山居苦行，食果服藥，與禽獸無異。遺教經云：汝等比丘，於我滅後，當尊重珍敬波羅提木叉，如暗遇明，如貧得寶。當知此則是汝等大師，若我住世，無異此也。吾佛世尊，於此戒法，痛切勸喻者既如此，殷勤付囑者又如此，可謂切要矣。嗟乎！世尊滅度已來，二千三百餘年矣，如今政是五濁惡世，末法之秋，眾生根器輕浮，無正知見，況值賢聖隱伏，邪法增熾。賢聖既已隱伏，則菩薩大戒，誰是諸佛慧命，法門正脉，却乃無人演說正法。既無人說，邪師得以縱橫，說邪法，行邪道，示邪見，傳邪解，惑亂愚蒙，󳯝相魔魅。縱有聰利根機，邪正不能自辨，亦不免隨邪入邪，毀謗正法。雖曰邪師過謬，非眾生咎，爭奈一盲引眾盲，相牽入火坑，此為大可哀痛者也。近代天目山高峰、中峰和尚，父子相承，乃是達磨正宗，臨濟正派，單提向上，直指人心。然每遇學者登門，必先使其立誓受戒。此乃知時別宜，隨機應變。發明佛佛相傳之意，力救今時墮邪之病，而大開甘露門者也。則上座忝紹遺風，不敢廢墜。今此現前一眾，皆具正信正解。宿於佛法，有大因緣。故能來我師子林中，如渴思飲，如饑思食。特發菩提大心，聽受菩薩大戒。此非小可事也。當生希有心，當作難遭想。當知成佛作祖，決定有分。既知有分，不可遷延。當念念護持，謹潔無犯。時時筞勵，勇猛精修。假使熱鐵輪，於我頂上旋。終不以此苦，退失菩提心。亦如度海須到岸，登山須到頂也。其有久參夙學，單提向上一著者。既知三聚為所宗，亦應知妙在用處。政當斷惡修善，饒益眾生之時。莫作斷修饒益之想，亦莫作善惡眾生之想。要於善惡眾生境上，無著無礙。於斷修饒益事上，無取無捨。不著有為，不住無為。雖知諸法本空，而不作空想。雖泛應群機，而栖心無寄。是名無止無作，無持無犯，理事一如之自性戒也。誠能如此奉戒，則可與單提向上一著，照用雙行，而互相筞發去也。亦猶良馬之遇康莊，復加鞭筞，勇往無前。忽爾踏著故家田地，方自信不歷僧祇獲法身，一超直入如來地。先聖之言，不汝欺也。到與麼時，更須知

Occurrences.Kwic: 。休不休？已不已？小釋迦有陷虎之機，老大蟲却無牙齒，當時一踏豈造次？驀然倒地非偶爾。眾中還有緇素得二老出者麼？良久，云：設有，也是掉棒打月。師云：小釋迦云：你作麼生用？岑大蟲便與一踏，盡謂高超物外，獨步寰中。天寧忍俊不禁，也擬冷處著把火。二大老如斯吐露於建化門頭，足可觀光。若是這箇事，料掉無交涉。舉：甘贄行者入南泉設齋，黃檗為首座。行者請施財，檗云：財法二施，等無差別。行者羿錢出去，須臾復云：請施財。檗云：財法二施，等無差別。行者乃行䞋。妙喜云：一等是隨邪逐惡，雲居羅漢却較些子。師云：恁麼恁麼，扶起甘贄，推倒黃檗；不恁麼不恁麼，扶起黃檗，推倒甘贄。只如恁麼中不恁麼，不恁麼中却恁麼，又作麼生？師子咬人，韓獹逐塊。舉：溈山同百丈入山作務，丈云：將得火來麼？溈云：有。丈云：在甚處？溈把一枝柴吹兩吹度與丈，云：如蟲御木。妙喜云：百丈若無後語，洎被典座謾。師云：百丈却因後語被人覰破，帶累典座隨邪逐惡。天寧幸是無事，汝等諸人來這裏覔箇什麼？一盲引眾盲，相牽入火坑。以拄杖一時趕散。舉：黃檗示眾云：汝等諸人盡是噇酒糟漢，與麼行脚，何處有今日？還知大唐國裏無禪師麼？時有僧云：只如諸方匡徒領眾又作麼生？檗云：不道無禪，只是無師。妙喜云：且道是醍醐句？毒藥句？師云：殺人刀，活人劍，具眼者辨取。舉：黃檗一日因南泉問：定慧等學，明會佛性，此理如何？檗云：十二時中不依倚一物始得。泉云：莫便是長老見處麼？檗云：不敢。泉云：漿錢且置，草鞋錢教誰還？檗休去。妙喜云：路逢劍客須呈劍，不是詩人不獻詩。師云：又是逢便宜？又是落便宜？舉仰山因僧問：法身還解說法也無？山云：我說不得，別有一人說得。僧云：說得底人在甚麼處？山乃推出枕子。溈山聞乃云：寂子用劍刃上事。妙喜云：溈山正是憐兒不覺醜。仰山推出枕子已是漏逗，更著名字喚作劍刃上事，悞他學語之流，便恁麼承虗接響流通將去。妙喜雖則借水獻花，要且理無曲斷。即今莫有傍不肯底出來？我要問你，推出枕子還當法身說法也無？師云：這僧問法身說法蹉過也，不知仰山推出枕子又何曾見大小？溈山將錯就錯，配作劍刃上事，縛作一束，秤上秤來八兩半斤，如無輕重。若也當時纔見這僧道法身還解說法也無，便驟步歸方丈，豈不是出格宗師？免得天下衲僧貶剝。舉：仰山因問香嚴：師弟近日有悟道頌，試舉看。遂舉擊竹

Occurrences.Kwic: 斷絕，而流裔受派者至今猶存。法眼一宗至永明壽大師，高麗嗣法者三十六人，其德澤滋盛，流溢遐遠，又不可以識心測之，謂其斷續也。洞山五傳至太陽玄，玄寄直裰皮履於遠公處，而得投子青，青得芙蓉楷，楷得丹霞淳，淳得長蘆了，了得天童珏，珏得雪竇鑑，乃至國初萬松秀、雪庭裕，展轉相傳，至我壽昌先和尚，實曹洞正傳，其源深流遠如此。臨濟至風穴，將墜於地，而得首山念，念得汾陽昭，昭得石霜圓，中興於世，乃至國初天如則、楚石琦，光明烜赫，至於天奇絕，以四家頌古，悉皆詮釋，宗風由此一變，識者惜焉。葢宗乘中事，貴在心髓相符，不獨在門庭相紹。故論其絕者，五宗皆絕；論其存者，五宗皆存。果得其人，則見知聞知，先後一揆，絕何甞絕？苟非其人，則乳添水而味薄，烏三寫而成馬，存豈真存？如居士所問，取之嚴者，得之必精；得之精者，傳之必遠。余意正然，不意居士亦見及此，所以寧不得人，勿授非器。不得人者，嗣雖絕而道真，自無傷於大法；授非器者，名雖傳而實偽，欺於心、欺於佛、欺於天下，一盲引眾盲，相牽入火坑，將來鑊湯爐炭、劒樹刀山，知是幾多劫數？有智之士寧可碎身如微塵，決不肯造此無間業也。今行棒行喝，豈但曰初披袈裟，即白衣居士例皆如此。殊不知古之所是，乃今之所非，如德山入門便棒，傳燈所載曾打幾人？又如臨濟大師一語中具三玄，一玄中具三要，四料揀、四賓主，皆於言句中勘人，未甞以棒盲加。且一語中具三玄三要，則一棒一喝悉當具三玄三要之旨。既一喝可分五教，一棒須具三玄，正應用時必有差別，其殺活縱奪貴在當機，豈沿街遍戶皆以棒喝為應用耶？若不審來機，一槩用打，是妄立門庭，便成戲論，引動一班狂妄學人墮落意坑見塹，硬作主宰，錯下承當，圖彼冬瓜印子，貪人禮拜供養，誑惑無識，各各自謂成無上道報，終決沉生死苦海，正所謂邪師過謬，非眾生咎。然在真為生死之人具眼參方，必不被其所賺。嗚呼！時丁末世，貴在辯正邪、別真偽，須向本分中商量徹底，莫向法嗣上較論斷續也。劉心城大參，問：千里餐風，連宵逼拶，大師大慈，石人墮淚。無奈迷雲，展轉濃重，索性全抒狂臆，以當發露懺悔。惟師慈父，容此驕子，不惜懡㦬，逐欵批答，令玄立地轉關，頓破葛藤絡索，豈愛剝皮析骨，詶此法乳深恩？師云：宗乘冷落，舉眼無親。今天下稱知識者，莫不云秉達磨大師單傳之旨，交馳棒喝，彌滿世間，豈但叢林？即街

ClaimAnchors.Kwic: 道：大用現前，不存軌則時如何？便與和聲一踏，待佗眼孔定動，老僧已入大石國裏去也。白頭因見韶山，山云：莫是多口白頭因麼？師云：白頭因口雖多，爭奈開了合不得？合了開不得，返不奈箇無口底何？徑山當時若見佗問：莫是多口白頭因麼？只向他道：這老賊前後觸忤多少賢良。以坐具便摵，直饒韶山手中有棒，亦無施展處。僧問：曹山抱璞投師，請師雕琢。師云：曹山雖不損花而得蜜，亦未免費口分疎。山僧即不然，或有人問：抱璞投師，請師雕琢。只向佗道：明朝更獻楚王看。稅闍梨問：曹山清稅孤貧，乞師賑濟。師云：老曹山雖則眼目睛明，爭奈放過稅闍梨？若是育王則不然，當時待佗恁麼問，拈起拄杖劈脊便打。何故？禮防君子。曹山辭洞山，洞山云：子向什麼處去？曹山云：不變異處去。洞山云：不變異處，豈有去耶？曹山云：去亦不變異。師云：好大眾！田地穩密，血脉貫通即不無，曹洞父子檢點將來，俗氣猶在。洞山萬里，無寸草處去。師云：二大老，一人下脚不得，一人擡脚不起，有人辨得，許你東去西去。洞山一盲引眾盲，相牽入火坑。石霜雖盡力𨁝跳，要且跳不出。鄮峰則不然，秋初夏末，兄弟東去西去，第一不得向萬里無寸草處去。何故？長安雖樂，不是久居。洞山雖則布漫天網，撈蝦蜆摝即得，若要羅龍打鳳則不可。後來石霜道：出門便是草。果然。臘月二十五師云：這公案往往多作奇特話會，便道雲門一曲韻出五音，殊不知這老漢等閑放屁，合著大石調。僧問雲門：秋初夏末，東去西去，忽有人問著，作麼生祗對？雲門云：退後，退後。僧云：某甲有什麼過？門云：還我九十日飯錢來。師云：雲門先鋒有作，殿後併吞，是則是，要且無大人相。徑山則不然，待佗道：某甲有什麼過？只向佗道：此去逢人但恁麼舉。雲門問僧：甚處來？僧云：嶽山來。門云：我尋常不曾與人葛藤來。僧近前。門云：去。師云：葛藤不少。僧問雲門：如何是直截一路？門云：主山後。僧云：謝師指示。門云：合取皮袋。師云：雲門大師是則是，直截未免飜成紆曲。徑山不然。或問：如何是直截一路？案：山前若言謝師指示，只向道：一任東行西行。雲門問僧：什麼處來？僧云：江西。門云：江西一隊老漢𥧌語住也未？僧無對。師乃云：噫！可惜許，好與劈口摑。當時既已放過，至今𥧌語未已。喝一喝。雲門放洞山三頓棒。師云：雲門前頭疑殺人，後頭笑殺人，洞山於言下悟去，更是好笑。如今莫有解笑底

ClaimAnchors.Kwic: 趣中王，一念回光，即得解脫。是故古德云：破戒受罪，終登解脫之場；不受不破，永墮泥犁之苦。瓔珞經云：若一切眾生，不受菩薩戒者，不名有情、識者、畜生無異，不名為人，常離三寶海，名為邪見，名為外道。智論云：譬如無足欲行，無翅欲飛，無船欲渡，是不可得。若無淨戒，欲求妙果，亦復如是。若人棄捨此戒，雖山居苦行，食果服藥，與禽獸無異。遺教經云：汝等比丘，於我滅後，當尊重珍敬波羅提木叉，如暗遇明，如貧得寶。當知此則是汝等大師，若我住世，無異此也。吾佛世尊，於此戒法，痛切勸喻者既如此，殷勤付囑者又如此，可謂切要矣。嗟乎！世尊滅度已來，二千三百餘年矣，如今政是五濁惡世，末法之秋，眾生根器輕浮，無正知見，況值賢聖隱伏，邪法增熾。賢聖既已隱伏，則菩薩大戒，誰是諸佛慧命，法門正脉，却乃無人演說正法。既無人說，邪師得以縱橫，說邪法，行邪道，示邪見，傳邪解，惑亂愚蒙，󳯝相魔魅。縱有聰利根機，邪正不能自辨，亦不免隨邪入邪，毀謗正法。雖曰邪師過謬，非眾生咎，爭奈一盲引眾盲，相牽入火坑，此為大可哀痛者也。近代天目山高峰、中峰和尚，父子相承，乃是達磨正宗，臨濟正派，單提向上，直指人心。然每遇學者登門，必先使其立誓受戒。此乃知時別宜，隨機應變。發明佛佛相傳之意，力救今時墮邪之病，而大開甘露門者也。則上座忝紹遺風，不敢廢墜。今此現前一眾，皆具正信正解。宿於佛法，有大因緣。故能來我師子林中，如渴思飲，如饑思食。特發菩提大心，聽受菩薩大戒。此非小可事也。當生希有心，當作難遭想。當知成佛作祖，決定有分。既知有分，不可遷延。當念念護持，謹潔無犯。時時筞勵，勇猛精修。假使熱鐵輪，於我頂上旋。終不以此苦，退失菩提心。亦如度海須到岸，登山須到頂也。其有久參夙學，單提向上一著者。既知三聚為所宗，亦應知妙在用處。政當斷惡修善，饒益眾生之時。莫作斷修饒益之想，亦莫作善惡眾生之想。要於善惡眾生境上，無著無礙。於斷修饒益事上，無取無捨。不著有為，不住無為。雖知諸法本空，而不作空想。雖泛應群機，而栖心無寄。是名無止無作，無持無犯，理事一如之自性戒也。誠能如此奉戒，則可與單提向上一著，照用雙行，而互相筞發去也。亦猶良馬之遇康莊，復加鞭筞，勇往無前。忽爾踏著故家田地，方自信不歷僧祇獲法身，一超直入如來地。先聖之言，不汝欺也。到與麼時，更須知

ClaimAnchors.ClaimText: 爭奈一盲引眾盲，相牽入火坑

ClaimAnchors.Kwic: 。休不休？已不已？小釋迦有陷虎之機，老大蟲却無牙齒，當時一踏豈造次？驀然倒地非偶爾。眾中還有緇素得二老出者麼？良久，云：設有，也是掉棒打月。師云：小釋迦云：你作麼生用？岑大蟲便與一踏，盡謂高超物外，獨步寰中。天寧忍俊不禁，也擬冷處著把火。二大老如斯吐露於建化門頭，足可觀光。若是這箇事，料掉無交涉。舉：甘贄行者入南泉設齋，黃檗為首座。行者請施財，檗云：財法二施，等無差別。行者羿錢出去，須臾復云：請施財。檗云：財法二施，等無差別。行者乃行䞋。妙喜云：一等是隨邪逐惡，雲居羅漢却較些子。師云：恁麼恁麼，扶起甘贄，推倒黃檗；不恁麼不恁麼，扶起黃檗，推倒甘贄。只如恁麼中不恁麼，不恁麼中却恁麼，又作麼生？師子咬人，韓獹逐塊。舉：溈山同百丈入山作務，丈云：將得火來麼？溈云：有。丈云：在甚處？溈把一枝柴吹兩吹度與丈，云：如蟲御木。妙喜云：百丈若無後語，洎被典座謾。師云：百丈却因後語被人覰破，帶累典座隨邪逐惡。天寧幸是無事，汝等諸人來這裏覔箇什麼？一盲引眾盲，相牽入火坑。以拄杖一時趕散。舉：黃檗示眾云：汝等諸人盡是噇酒糟漢，與麼行脚，何處有今日？還知大唐國裏無禪師麼？時有僧云：只如諸方匡徒領眾又作麼生？檗云：不道無禪，只是無師。妙喜云：且道是醍醐句？毒藥句？師云：殺人刀，活人劍，具眼者辨取。舉：黃檗一日因南泉問：定慧等學，明會佛性，此理如何？檗云：十二時中不依倚一物始得。泉云：莫便是長老見處麼？檗云：不敢。泉云：漿錢且置，草鞋錢教誰還？檗休去。妙喜云：路逢劍客須呈劍，不是詩人不獻詩。師云：又是逢便宜？又是落便宜？舉仰山因僧問：法身還解說法也無？山云：我說不得，別有一人說得。僧云：說得底人在甚麼處？山乃推出枕子。溈山聞乃云：寂子用劍刃上事。妙喜云：溈山正是憐兒不覺醜。仰山推出枕子已是漏逗，更著名字喚作劍刃上事，悞他學語之流，便恁麼承虗接響流通將去。妙喜雖則借水獻花，要且理無曲斷。即今莫有傍不肯底出來？我要問你，推出枕子還當法身說法也無？師云：這僧問法身說法蹉過也，不知仰山推出枕子又何曾見大小？溈山將錯就錯，配作劍刃上事，縛作一束，秤上秤來八兩半斤，如無輕重。若也當時纔見這僧道法身還解說法也無，便驟步歸方丈，豈不是出格宗師？免得天下衲僧貶剝。舉：仰山因問香嚴：師弟近日有悟道頌，試舉看。遂舉擊竹

ClaimAnchors.Kwic: 斷絕，而流裔受派者至今猶存。法眼一宗至永明壽大師，高麗嗣法者三十六人，其德澤滋盛，流溢遐遠，又不可以識心測之，謂其斷續也。洞山五傳至太陽玄，玄寄直裰皮履於遠公處，而得投子青，青得芙蓉楷，楷得丹霞淳，淳得長蘆了，了得天童珏，珏得雪竇鑑，乃至國初萬松秀、雪庭裕，展轉相傳，至我壽昌先和尚，實曹洞正傳，其源深流遠如此。臨濟至風穴，將墜於地，而得首山念，念得汾陽昭，昭得石霜圓，中興於世，乃至國初天如則、楚石琦，光明烜赫，至於天奇絕，以四家頌古，悉皆詮釋，宗風由此一變，識者惜焉。葢宗乘中事，貴在心髓相符，不獨在門庭相紹。故論其絕者，五宗皆絕；論其存者，五宗皆存。果得其人，則見知聞知，先後一揆，絕何甞絕？苟非其人，則乳添水而味薄，烏三寫而成馬，存豈真存？如居士所問，取之嚴者，得之必精；得之精者，傳之必遠。余意正然，不意居士亦見及此，所以寧不得人，勿授非器。不得人者，嗣雖絕而道真，自無傷於大法；授非器者，名雖傳而實偽，欺於心、欺於佛、欺於天下，一盲引眾盲，相牽入火坑，將來鑊湯爐炭、劒樹刀山，知是幾多劫數？有智之士寧可碎身如微塵，決不肯造此無間業也。今行棒行喝，豈但曰初披袈裟，即白衣居士例皆如此。殊不知古之所是，乃今之所非，如德山入門便棒，傳燈所載曾打幾人？又如臨濟大師一語中具三玄，一玄中具三要，四料揀、四賓主，皆於言句中勘人，未甞以棒盲加。且一語中具三玄三要，則一棒一喝悉當具三玄三要之旨。既一喝可分五教，一棒須具三玄，正應用時必有差別，其殺活縱奪貴在當機，豈沿街遍戶皆以棒喝為應用耶？若不審來機，一槩用打，是妄立門庭，便成戲論，引動一班狂妄學人墮落意坑見塹，硬作主宰，錯下承當，圖彼冬瓜印子，貪人禮拜供養，誑惑無識，各各自謂成無上道報，終決沉生死苦海，正所謂邪師過謬，非眾生咎。然在真為生死之人具眼參方，必不被其所賺。嗚呼！時丁末世，貴在辯正邪、別真偽，須向本分中商量徹底，莫向法嗣上較論斷續也。劉心城大參，問：千里餐風，連宵逼拶，大師大慈，石人墮淚。無奈迷雲，展轉濃重，索性全抒狂臆，以當發露懺悔。惟師慈父，容此驕子，不惜懡㦬，逐欵批答，令玄立地轉關，頓破葛藤絡索，豈愛剝皮析骨，詶此法乳深恩？師云：宗乘冷落，舉眼無親。今天下稱知識者，莫不云秉達磨大師單傳之旨，交馳棒喝，彌滿世間，豈但叢林？即街

ClaimAnchors.ClaimText: 一盲引眾盲，相牽入火坑

Senses.Explanation: One blind guide leads the blind; together they fall into a fire pit warns that untested guidance can endanger everyone who follows it. Baichi uses the image while warning students against merely following the Buddha’s tracks. Miyun gives it after a monk cannot say where the way out lies. Daxiu applies it to teachers who readily approve a student’s shallow answer and send more imitators into the world. Wuzhun turns the charge against a famous older exchange. Tianru warns that mistaken teachers can lead even gifted students astray. Chushi tells an assembly seeking him that they risk following one blind person with another. Wuyi uses it in a letter warning that giving transmission to an unfit successor harms later learners.

Senses.Note: After Mazu looks downward, layman Pang calls it a stringless zither played wonderfully by the master. Miyun proposes a blow instead of leaving the compliment intact. Senses.Note: The Lotus verse says that a single call of homage to the Buddha has already joined the Buddha Way. Tianan makes understanding the verse decisive: without it, the journey remains long. Baochi asks how this fits Zhaozhou’s refusal even to hear the word Buddha. Hansong mocks the old distinction as overdrawn, while Wuyi reads the unsettled mind as arising through conditions and lacking fixed nature. The later turns test the verse’s promise rather than treating repetition as a mechanical result.

Senses.Explanation: The iron stake figures unyielding fixity. Xueyan remembers a practitioner whose posture was stake-like; Yuanan imagines a forged stake no buddha or patriarch can shift; Lianyue prescribes steady practice through praise and blame. Wuyi independently says that Boshan forged the teachings into such a stake, extending the figure to doctrinal work. Retained public meaning is supported by independent present uses in recorded discourse.

Senses.Note: A nose has two nostrils but breathes as one organ. Masters use the line when a question asks whether two teachers or two acts of teaching are the same or different. It gives an image of shared source and distinct openings without reducing the exchange to a simple yes or no.

Senses.Explanation: One arrow brings down two eagles is an image for one response or action considered in relation to two targets or strands. When two monks rush out together and one asks which of two dragons gets the pearl, Baiyu Jingsi strikes and gives this answer; he rejects the monk's ensuing thanks as unrelated. Lianfeng applies the image to Zhaozhou Congshen's two hermit encounters but immediately calls the result 'a dragon's head and a snake's tail.' Pufeng Fazhudong likewise reports that the various quarters apply it to Fengxue Yanzhao's encounter, then says his own staff still does not permit that appraisal. The Five Lamps Compendium preserves Fengxue himself answering with the phrase when asked about one and six both vanishing. The image therefore remains literal while its recorded appraisals may be affirmed, qualified, or refused.

Senses.Explanation: The phrase names complete nakedness and is extended to a person from whom nothing further can be stripped or removed. Literally, “not hanging a single thread”: not wearing even one strand of clothing. The late Chan records deploy nakedness as a description of a person after successive stripping: Xueguan compares it to taking off clothes and undoing a belt, layer after layer, then asks what could still be removed from “a fellow not wearing a single thread”. Other records pair the phrase with “coming and going freely” or with “the myriad forms all manifest”. The Zen bend is therefore directly visible in its use as an appraisal of a person rather than only a state of undress. The records do not define an inner state behind the image, and this entry does not supply one.

Senses.Explanation: A single thread-tip means the slightest trace or narrow opening, with force supplied by its predicate. The old records use it for a tiny residue, deficit, or opening to be shown. Shiqi forbids even a thread of movement during retreat, Sanyi leaves a thread for later growth, Yinyuan rejects a thread of attachment, and Fangrong opens a thread of release. Retained public meaning is supported by independent present uses in recorded discourse.

Senses.Explanation: A slight obstruction of seeing can multiply into a whole field of illusory appearances. Chan speakers use the paired image to expose the consequences of clinging to a view. Miyun warns that a meeting can undo expectation built from a name, then ends with the saying. Xueguan says clinging to even one thought of body, reputation, or doctrinal learning becomes the obscuring film. Huizhou caps the Old Woman's attempt to avoid the Buddha with the saying and asks for her meaning. Gulin contrasts one moon reflected in many waters with a single eye-film that makes empty flowers appear.

Senses.PreferredTarget: one film over the eye, empty flowers falling everywhere
AlternateTargets: one eye-film; a wild fall of empty flowers
Senses.Note: The corpus itself supplies the causal pair: the eye-film comes first and the empty flowers multiply from it. The entry reports that observable relation without importing a theory of perception.

Senses.Explanation: A bellyful of Chan is accumulated verbal learning carried around as personal stock. The records place it with learned sayings, encounter phrases, scriptural argument, and rehearsed replies, then criticize that stock as obstructive or lifeless when it governs an encounter. Yuanwu Keqin describes Longya as travelling with a bellyful of Chan before his meetings with Cuiwei and Linji. Hanyue Fazang names Chan sayings, encounter phrases, and scriptural learning as its contents. Yunwai Xingze and Shengke Deyu use the phrase while criticizing students who answer from acquired verbal material.

Senses.PreferredTarget: One lift, forty-nine
Senses.Note: “One lift, forty-nine” is deliberately compressed. Yunmen says it after Xuefeng spreads his hands to show a temple design. Hanxiu gives it when asked how to refine someone who has passed beyond holy and ordinary forms. Yian pairs an outstretched hand with questions from all places and times. Luyan gives it for a response that borrows from no one; Pinjixiang sets it beside “mind is Buddha.” Pufu voices it while raising a staff on Buddha’s birthday. The line turns a wide field into one immediate move; these sources do not decode forty-nine as one stable calculation.

Senses.Explanation: A single lift is set beside forty-nine, making a compact response out of a wide field. Yunmen, Hanxiu, and Yian attach the formula to different gestures and questions. Luyan, Pinjixiang, and Pufu redeploy it without supplying one fixed count.

Entries.SourceTerm: 一般清意味，料得少人知

Senses.PreferredTarget: The same clear flavor is here; I expect few people know it
AlternateTargets: One common, lucid savor remains, though few will recognize it
SearchAliases: same clear flavor few know Chan
Senses.Note: The words say there is a shared clear flavor, yet few people recognize it. Sanyi turns a monk’s line into his own question to the assembly; Minshu, Baichi, Zixian, and Yuanjie each use it in a fresh response. In the older full poem the flavor follows moon at the sky’s center and wind over water. In these sermons the closing pair can answer by itself, while the preceding images remain part of its family.

Occurrences.Kwic: 拍拍是令，啟悟開迷，轉凡成聖。設有箇漢出來道：『驪龍頷下寶珠如何摘得？猛虎項下金鈴怎生解得？』老僧向道：『去，扣取堂中第一座。』」結制，請上堂。僧問：「解行相應成底事，非同口說義忘言。如何是底事？」師曰：「香煙騰碧漢。」曰：「紅爐三七，點鐵成金。設遇不受鉗鎚的衲僧到來，未審如何煆煉？」師曰：「千鈞之弩，不為鼷鼠。」乃卓拄杖，曰：「諸佛不以眼覷，諸祖不以耳聞。天下知識雖則口裏水漉漉底，到者裏秪堪喫飯𡬡耐。黃面老人生下地來，便道天下獨尊獨占在世界裏，韶陽冷地裏放不過，只要一棒打殺，貴圖天下太平。殊不知靈龜曳尾，拂跡成痕，不免各與三十。何故？雲門今日結制。」便下座。上堂。「仲冬十五，霜風凄楚，水冷冰寒，月圓當戶。在迦葉不貧，在釋迦不富，無端舜若多神，打失自己南山。老虎喫卻大蟲，帶累露柱燈籠，顢顢頇頇，不啻恒河沙數。報諸人，莫莽鹵，除卻此見聞，莫昧主中主。」祈嗣，請上堂。僧問：「未芳花木春常在，已老松筠更好看。畢竟明甚麼邊事？」師曰：「一般清意味，料得少人知。」曰：「經聲夜息聞天語，爐氣晨飄接御香。如何是雲門風境？」師曰：「一任古今看。」曰：「石傘峰前龍虎客，玉笥宮下象獅群。如何是境中人？」師曰：「瞻之仰之。」曰：「放去禹門三級浪，收來平地一聲雷。如何是人中意？」師曰：「你不是其人。」乃曰：「寒風括地，曉日暉霜。明明聲色難該，歷歷覆藏不得。繁興大用，舉必全真。妙協投機，不存軌則。只如人天交慶，奕葉聯芳一句又作麼生？夢回槐國知春蚤，信有靈根夙種人。」薦亡，請上堂。僧問：「城市盡同悲薤露，山林誰共語冰霜？如何是薦拔一句？」師曰：「金地遙招手，江心暗點頭。」曰：「恁麼則葉君親獲生安養，徐女猶聞心遠香。」師曰：「七通八達。」遂舉手，曰：「者不是七寶蓮池，者不是金繩界道，者不是惟心淨土，者不是彌陀授記，者不是森如居士親聞正法、契悟無生。」良久，曰：「不聞有相揩今古，能使忘言洞海桑。」便下座。天華為則和尚至，引座。「天華和尚啟中有曰：『舉揚宗旨，獎示後昆。』者些子則吾豈敢？山僧未出方丈、未陞法座，不止七花八裂了也，又那堪說甚五位三玄、正偏滲漏、暗機七事、影草隨身、一鏃撩空、三句可辨，乃至燃燈義海九十七箇、總別同異成壞六門，一一條章，種種緒聒。雖然如是，泥牛吼處天關轉，木馬嘶時地軸搖，你者一

ClaimAnchors.Kwic: 機一境，立一事一法，皆可美流萬世譽播今時。丈夫漢都不分外，但山僧從來與這些窠臼無緣，如鍼氈石壁相似。不惟無縫罅可入，亦且坐住不得，蓋為資性魯鈍，自幼失師友之教，迄今老大無成。所以四十年來，墨突不黔，孔席不煖，奔馳雲水之間，嘯傲煙霞之際，有時與林處士把臂孤山麓，有時與韜光師話會冷泉亭。不意寒蟲蟄戶不緊，被業風吹到宗會這裏，與諸仁者眉毛廝結，搆海大冤讎，你一箇箇頭角崢嶸，山僧秖可慚惶有分。今日眾居士，又把山僧逼拶到寶華座上人天眾前，其奈腹中原無一點墨水。」驀展兩手云：「教我說箇甚麼？蒼天！蒼天！大眾！八十婆婆舊話頭，買些脂粉賣風流，招人談笑惹人羞，只得無言下翠樓。」以袖掩面，踊身下座。上堂。「一聲雞唱五更中，多少英靈一夢同。卻怪道人閒理會，樓頭又打曉來鐘。」遂擊拂一下，下座。上堂。僧問：「鳥啼華笑風動塵起，明明西來意，為甚學人不會？」師云：「爭怪得老僧。」僧顧左右，師一喝，僧云：「一般清意味，料得少人知。」師乃豎拂子云：「大眾會麼？一般清意味，料得少人知。若真師子兒，不入他群隊。提持佛祖命脈，開張向上綱宗，移星轉斗，緯地經天，橫衝直撞，左右逢原，向肉案頭展具，酒樓上闖席，憨布袋十字街等人，豐干老方丈中養虎，袈裟裏艸鞋，赤腳下桐城，得大自在。如風奮迅三昧，所以測識他不得，名目他不得，趨向他不得，比擬他不得。如水中木，不住此岸，不住彼岸，不著中流，順流而入薩婆若海、三昧海、智慧海、福德海、壽量海、神通光明海。此也是你本有底，山僧到這裏添減他一絲毫不得。適有一事與諸人商量，僧問趙州：『至道無難，唯嫌揀擇。豈不是時人窠臼？』州云：『曾有人問老僧，直得五年分疏不下。』」拈拄杖卓一下橫几上，乃屈指云：「一祖摩訶迦葉，一祖阿難，三祖商那和脩，四祖優波鞠多。」喝一喝云：「若不喝住，數到明朝。」擿拄杖顧左右云：「漆桶不快。」上堂。「密室深閨不見人，縱然桃李未逢春。偶來月下調絃管，隔院梅華照比鄰。」豎拂子云：「賊身已露。」上堂。拈拄杖云：「見麼？」卓一下，云：「聞麼？即此見聞非見聞，無餘聲色可呈君。」舉拄杖云：「此是體橫案上，云此是用。箇中若了全無事，體用何妨分不分？所以一句能該八萬門，說甚麼雲門胡餅？一機迥超生死路，又何須趙老清茶？若是懸照妖鏡，秉昆吾刀，坐斷十方，冶鑄古今，便見天平地成萬民

ClaimAnchors.Kwic: 拍拍是令，啟悟開迷，轉凡成聖。設有箇漢出來道：『驪龍頷下寶珠如何摘得？猛虎項下金鈴怎生解得？』老僧向道：『去，扣取堂中第一座。』」結制，請上堂。僧問：「解行相應成底事，非同口說義忘言。如何是底事？」師曰：「香煙騰碧漢。」曰：「紅爐三七，點鐵成金。設遇不受鉗鎚的衲僧到來，未審如何煆煉？」師曰：「千鈞之弩，不為鼷鼠。」乃卓拄杖，曰：「諸佛不以眼覷，諸祖不以耳聞。天下知識雖則口裏水漉漉底，到者裏秪堪喫飯𡬡耐。黃面老人生下地來，便道天下獨尊獨占在世界裏，韶陽冷地裏放不過，只要一棒打殺，貴圖天下太平。殊不知靈龜曳尾，拂跡成痕，不免各與三十。何故？雲門今日結制。」便下座。上堂。「仲冬十五，霜風凄楚，水冷冰寒，月圓當戶。在迦葉不貧，在釋迦不富，無端舜若多神，打失自己南山。老虎喫卻大蟲，帶累露柱燈籠，顢顢頇頇，不啻恒河沙數。報諸人，莫莽鹵，除卻此見聞，莫昧主中主。」祈嗣，請上堂。僧問：「未芳花木春常在，已老松筠更好看。畢竟明甚麼邊事？」師曰：「一般清意味，料得少人知。」曰：「經聲夜息聞天語，爐氣晨飄接御香。如何是雲門風境？」師曰：「一任古今看。」曰：「石傘峰前龍虎客，玉笥宮下象獅群。如何是境中人？」師曰：「瞻之仰之。」曰：「放去禹門三級浪，收來平地一聲雷。如何是人中意？」師曰：「你不是其人。」乃曰：「寒風括地，曉日暉霜。明明聲色難該，歷歷覆藏不得。繁興大用，舉必全真。妙協投機，不存軌則。只如人天交慶，奕葉聯芳一句又作麼生？夢回槐國知春蚤，信有靈根夙種人。」薦亡，請上堂。僧問：「城市盡同悲薤露，山林誰共語冰霜？如何是薦拔一句？」師曰：「金地遙招手，江心暗點頭。」曰：「恁麼則葉君親獲生安養，徐女猶聞心遠香。」師曰：「七通八達。」遂舉手，曰：「者不是七寶蓮池，者不是金繩界道，者不是惟心淨土，者不是彌陀授記，者不是森如居士親聞正法、契悟無生。」良久，曰：「不聞有相揩今古，能使忘言洞海桑。」便下座。天華為則和尚至，引座。「天華和尚啟中有曰：『舉揚宗旨，獎示後昆。』者些子則吾豈敢？山僧未出方丈、未陞法座，不止七花八裂了也，又那堪說甚五位三玄、正偏滲漏、暗機七事、影草隨身、一鏃撩空、三句可辨，乃至燃燈義海九十七箇、總別同異成壞六門，一一條章，種種緒聒。雖然如是，泥牛吼處天關轉，木馬嘶時地軸搖，你者一

Senses.Explanation: The one-color edge is the limit of an undifferentiated, pure-looking field: masters use it for a place an answer or person can reach, inhabit, or become trapped in, and then demand movement beyond it. An unnamed monk calls borrowed expression merely a one-color-edge matter. Xisou Shaotan praises not falling there; Yuanwu Keqin requires personal breakthrough and an encounter even after reaching it. A layman places Xueqiao Yuanxin’s white-on-white image there, and Xueqiao overturns the appraisal. Tianyin Yuanxiu warns that people sit there, while Xueyan Zuqin attacks the claim that snow itself reveals it. The image can mark purity, uniformity, or the absence of visible distinction, but the records repeatedly make that very attainment a possible stopping place. It is therefore not a color description and not an automatic name for completion.

Senses.Explanation: One flower, five leaves: a compact image for a teaching lineage spreading from one root into several branches. Masters use it at ancestral halls, transmission ceremonies and seasonal talks, sometimes celebrating the spread and sometimes questioning the stock story behind it. Juelang Daosheng draws a circle with his staff and says the flower opens there, making transmission immediate in the room. Huigong Kaixiong gives the inherited flower verse a skeptical response: the celebrated five leaves can be a story that misleads people. Konggu Daocheng offers incense to his teacher and images one flower bearing five leaves in the eastern land. Zhufeng Zhenxu writes the phrase in a verse for a younger descendant, saying the family line spreads everywhere. At an ancestral hall, Chushi Fanqi states the phrase and asks where its beginning is to be found. Yun'e Xi burns incense for an ancestor and turns the flower into an unending bloom, its scent moving through the ages. Guantao Daqi brings the image into a New Year's hall verse, then tests whether the assembly knows if the turn belongs to old precedent or the present occasion.

Senses.Explanation: One flower opens five petals and bears fruit naturally is Bodhidharma's transmitted lineage verse. Chan records repeatedly take the verse back into public use: direct transmission, lineage exposition, hall capping, and criticism of descendants who calculate its flower and fruit. Bodhidharma recites the verse to Huike in the Patriarchs’ Hall Anthology. Senses.Explanation: A single blade of grass is lifted, used, or contrasted with a great body and the whole earth in recurring public statements. The Chan corpus loads this smallest ordinary object through a set of reversible public formulas. Most prominently, Mi'an Xianjie may 'take a single blade of grass and make it a sixteen-foot golden body, and take the sixteen-foot golden body and make it a single blade of grass.' The same blade can found a monastery or display jeweled halls and jade palaces. Baiyun Duan's saying makes the relation reversible: after one true sweat, jeweled halls appear atop a blade of grass; without it, even jeweled halls are covered by the blade. Dahui accepts the first clause but warns that the second may deceive the hearer. A separate inherited encounter supplies another use: Sudhana picks a blade of grass from the ground as the medicine requested by Manjusri, who says that this medicine can kill and can give life. The Chan-specific bend lies in how the records repeatedly place the concrete blade in reversible comparison with a buddha-body, a monastery, palaces, and medicine, while later masters quote, test, and qualify those formulas.

Senses.PreferredTarget: Make a blade of grass into a sixteen-foot golden body
SearchAliases: make a blade of grass into a sixteen-foot golden body
Senses.Note: A stalk of grass can be used as a sixteen-foot golden body, and the golden body as grass. Zhuanyu says that freedom requires passing through both worldly and otherworldly categories. Liao’an asks why the reversal is possible now when it was not before; Yuansou connects it with a mind no longer divided into six isolated functions. Zisu calls even this sweeping range a ripple, while Gulin says it is not a place to stop. Miyun voices the pair and turns his staff before the assembly. The scale change tests use, not the material size of an object.

Senses.Explanation: A single grass stalk becomes a towering golden Buddha body in a saying about freedom of scale and use. Zhuanyu, Liao’an, and Yuansou each pair the transformation with its reverse and test what permits either move. Senses.PreferredTarget: One flower opens into five petals; the fruit forms of itself
AlternateTargets: A single flower blooms in five petals, and the fruit comes naturally
SearchAliases: one flower five petals fruit naturally forms
Senses.Note: The pair closes a verse attributed in these records to Bodhidharma: a single flower opens into five petals and bears fruit. Later teachers bring the image into new settings. Sanyi asks what kind of fruit has appeared before his assembly; the Tianwang master gives his own ordination verse; Chijue questions the inherited claim; and Shuzhong recites it at a memorial while pointing beyond the old words.

Occurrences.Kwic: 撥開千嶂。雲：打一圓相。云：放出一輪月。光未生時薦得親，依然眼裏重添屑。靠拄杖，下座。上堂，舉：廓侍者問德山：從上諸聖向什麼處去？山云：作麼？作麼？廓云：勑點飛龍馬，跛鱉出頭來。山休去。明日浴出，廓過茶與山，山拊廓背云：昨日公案如何？廓云：這老漢今日方始鱉地。師云：編虎鬚、撩虎尾則不無，這僧幾不免於虎口。老德山雖則徹底放憨，要且瞞光孝眼不得。上堂。盡大地是諸人本來面目，因什麼眼不見鼻孔？直饒倜儻分明，未免錯認驢鞍橋作阿爺下頷。且世界未立、父母未生已前如何通信？良久，云：少年曾決龍蛇陣，老倒慵聽稚子歌。謝首座、藏主、維那，上堂。砧椎未動已前，一大藏教字義炳然，三世諸佛口挂壁上。正常恁麼時，且道是誰家風月、人天眼目、古今牓樣？便下座。上堂：凡所有相，皆是虗妄。懷州牛喫禾，益州馬腹脹。若見諸相非相，即見如來。一切難捨，無過己財。驀舉拂子召大眾云：釋迦老子來也，還見麼？良久云：巡堂喫茶去。上堂，舉：達磨大師頌云：吾本來茲土，傳法救迷情，一華開五葉，結果自然成。師云：以左道惑民，必殺無赦。然雖如是，不因柳毅傳書信，爭見龍王宮殿深？久雨，上堂。拈拄杖，畫圓相，召大眾，云：還見麼？赫日當空。擲下拄杖，云：群陰自伏。便下座。上堂，舉：法眼示眾云：盡十方世界，皎皎地無一絲頭。若有一絲頭，即是一絲頭。師云：歷相六國，未是良謀；餓死首陽，豈為奇䇿？古人鬼家活計，為諸人點破了也。還知光孝立地處麼？良久，云：縣古槐根出，官清馬骨高。源首座至，上堂。一不得向，二不得背，絲毫及不盡，古鏡生瑕纇。驀拈拄杖，云：拈起鐵蒺䔧。卓一下，云：一時俱擊碎。擲下拄杖，云：從教大地黑漫漫，它家自有通人會。上堂。會則事同一家。拍禪床一下，云：且道浮幢王剎海外還有這箇消息也無？不會則萬別千差。衲僧家行但行、坐但坐，萬別千差有什麼過？良久，云：參。上堂。盡大地是諸人自己，草芥人畜向甚處著？直饒見得透脫，正是老鼠孔裏作活計。左邊拍禪床一下，云：拈向這邊著，只如常啼菩薩賣却心肝，畢竟教誰學般若？良久，云：罪不重科。上堂。正人說邪法，邪法悉皆正；邪人說正法，正法悉皆邪。驀召大眾，云：與其譽堯而非桀，孰若兩忘而化於道？然雖如是，時人應笑我，解笑者還稀。聖節，上堂。瑞慶聖節，不免講一遍人王護國經，祝延聖壽。乃竪起拂子，召大眾，云：

Occurrences.Kwic: 見鼻孔。進云：曹溪流，非止水，一滴忽來，千波競起時如何？師云：退後，退後。進云：平生不解藏人善，到處逢人說項斯。師云：莫謗山僧好。又僧問：天不言，四時行；地不言，萬物生。學人有疑，願聞開示。師云：萬人遐仰處，紅日到天心。進云：野老不知堯舜力，鼕鼕打鼓祭江神。師云：眼見如盲，口說如啞。進云：千古華山山脚下，又添潘閬倒騎驢。師便喝，僧禮拜，師乃云：建法幢，立宗旨，拓開無上妙門，顯示第一義諦。天何寬？地何窄？青山不青，白雲不白。十字街頭醉翁子，夢裡惺惺；三家村裡臭胡猻，甚生標格。掀翻是非窠窟，截斷凡聖蹤由。德山棒頭，全彰大用；臨濟喝下，脫體風流。垂衣正裳。聖天子繼唐虞之化。修文偃武。賢宰相霈霖雨之秋。所以道。一毛見神變。一切佛同說。經於無量劫。不得其邊際。喝一喝云。將謂合有恁麼說話。拈拄杖云。拄杖子穿過諸人鼻孔即不問。梁寶公騎佛殿出山門。畢竟成得箇什麼事。卓拄杖云。千尺鯨噴洪浪飛。一聲雷震清猋起。復舉：祖師云：吾本來此土，傳法救迷情，一華開五葉，結果自然成。五祖法演和尚云：達磨大師信脚來，信口道，後代兒孫多成計較。諸人要會開華結果處麼？鄭州梨，青州棗，萬物無過出處好。師云：提本分鉗鎚，碎情解窠窟，還他五祖老人要見開華結果處則大遠在。諸人要會開華結果處麼？拈却鄭州梨，放下青州棗，出門便是長安道。久立，珍重！小參。鳳凰臺上對三山，嘯月眠雲趣自閑，一疏忽從天外至，又移身入閙籃間。是知道人行處如火消氷，動靜去來該他不著，一抽三、二添四，截鐵斬釘、和泥合水，有來由、無本據，擊碎上頭關，千華生碓觜。豈不見長沙和尚云：百尺竿頭坐底人，雖然得入未為真，百竿尺頭重進步，十方世界見全身。拈拄杖，云：騎駿馬，驟高樓，萬里銀河輥玉毬。卓拄杖，云：有時乘好月，不覺過滄洲。復舉：德山小參不答話，問話者三十棒。時有僧出，德山劈脊便棒，僧云：某甲話也未問，因甚便打？山云：你是甚處人？僧云：新羅人。山云：未跨船舷，好與三十棒。後來此菴元和尚拈云：忒殺倚勢欺人，山僧見處也要諸人共知。者僧當時若是箇漢，待他道：你是甚處人？便與掀倒禪床，踢起便行。直饒德山牙如劍樹、口似血盆，也須倒退三千。何故？識法者懼。師云：德山正令當行，者僧黠兒落節；若謂倚勢欺人，屈他先德不少。雖然，還知此菴老人落處麼？劍為不平離寶匣，藥因救病

Occurrences.Kwic: 奔。上堂：坐深井者，不知太虗之寬廣。忘偏見者，方明至理之圓融。與麼說話，譬如以大地作射垛，挽弓所向，無不中的。眾中忽有出來道：如斯舉唱，今古罕聞。山僧喚侍者點一椀茶供養他。更有出來道：如斯舉唱，未稱全提。亦喚侍者點一椀茶供養他。且道還有為人處也無？雪壓難摧㵎底松，風吹不動天邊月。上堂：大智非明，真空絕跡。三世諸佛，只言自知。六代祖師，全提不起。今日抑不得已，向諸人面前說東道西，大似巡官犯夜。卓拄杖，神龍一舉透無邊，纖鱗猶向泥中躍。上堂：古人吐露一言半句，要控諸人得箇入處；瑞巖不以一言半句為事，也要控諸人得箇入處。古人說而不說，瑞巖不說而說。且道是一合相？非一合相？開爐，上堂。楊岐和尚示眾云：薄福住楊岐，年來氣力疎，寒風凋敗葉，猶喜故人歸。囉囉哩，拈起死柴頭，且向無煙火。山僧雖忝末裔，要且不與同塵。薄福住鞔峯，多嗔還少喜，此日話開爐，火種無些子。報諸人，休儗議，大家收足上蒲團，今歲立春在年裏。祖忌，拈香云：吾本來茲土，傳法救迷情，一華開五葉，結果自然成。舉香，召云：大眾！達磨大師面目現在，巍巍堂堂，離一切見。上堂。當言不避截舌，當爐不避火迸。便請全身檐荷，何必再三勞讓。巢和風，穴知雨，兩箇石人相耳語。百丈搊得鼻頭穿，野鴨成羣自飛去。喝一喝。多福、秋江和尚至，并侍者進退，上堂：通宗通途，挾帶挾路，一句全提，萬機頓赴。僧問多福：如何是多福一叢竹？福云：一莖兩莖斜。僧云：學人不會。福云：三莖四莖曲。奇怪諸禪德！是牛鼻勒芒繩，是馬口㗸生鐵，提妙明之心印，用格外之生機，還他多福始得。且者僧與麼問，還有孤負處麼？金鷄啼向玉闌干，一聲直透須彌頂。冬節，小參。始見重陽，又逢冬至。大法本無變遷，寒暑自成來去。是以，山僧自到此山，首尾將及二載，運水搬柴、迎賓送客，與諸人同一眼見、同一耳聞、同一心思意想、同一鼻嗅舌甞。山僧移易諸人，一絲毫不得；諸人移易山僧，一絲毫不得。所以道：是法平等，無有高下。又有道：具足凡夫法，凡夫不知；具足聖人法，聖人不會。聖人若會，即同凡夫；凡夫若知，即同聖人。與麼說話，大似掩耳偷鈴，今夜打動法鼓。集眾，小參。不說同法，不說異法，不說不同不異法。若是皮下有血底，向者裏翻身一擲，抹過太虗，便見覺城東際，始見文殊；樓閣門開，方參慈氏。總是鬼家活計，日下孤燈。喝一喝：好事不

ClaimAnchors.Kwic: 關、雲門關、黃龍關，直是橫身而行掉臂而過。所以道：『家國興盛，野老寧怗，地平天成，河清海晏，風不鳴條，雨不破塊。』況進于此者，舉一念動一步，遊歷十方恒河沙世界，承事恒河沙諸佛，聞恒河沙諸佛所說玅法，證無量三昧門，得無量陀羅尼門，此也是你腳前腳後底事。有般漢只管提燈覓火、家裏問程，山僧亦聽其自然，卻不道甕中走卻鱉。」以拂子打圜相云：「大眾！正覺山頭月一輪，不分晝夜照乾坤，昨宵拋向波心裏，自是魚龍不解吞。」擊拂子三下。果園請上堂：「欲識佛性義，當觀時節因緣。時節若至，其理自明，綠橘黃柑，未霜而摘，何異退華杏子、落地楊梅，滋味全無，徒增酸澀。既不能益于己，又不可利于人。海外有蟠桃，一華一實，各三千年，果熟香飄，法利人天。若是嘗禪師，梅子雖熟，吞得吐不得，甘蔗種一枝，掃土而盡。須知有向上一著衲僧巴鼻，於此轉得身來，方堪受用。所以象骨山老漢拈一顆荔枝，塞斷天下人咽喉。有箇泰首座果子，方到口邊一口吞卻。是以祖師道：『吾本來茲土，傳法救迷情。一華開五葉，結果自然成。』」豎拂子云：「大眾！華開也。且道成箇甚麼？菴摩勒，毘黎勒，訶黎勒。」喝一喝，下座。商韋緒居士捐軀死義大祥，請上堂，豎拂子云：「會麼？百尺竿頭舍得性命，鍼鋒上也好走馬，陸地上也好行船。諸兄弟！你一往底秖抱得箇不哭孩兒，總不曾經過毒拳、毒掌、惡棒、惡捶，所以臨敵而怯，見事而餒。你看他古來豪傑之士，從容就義，殺身成仁，視死如歸，不可枚舉。更看他肇法師就白刃似斬清風，巖頭老一吼等若雷轟，有此等志勇，有如是氣骨，方堪紹述吾宗。刀山劍樹，縱身遊歷，鑊湯爐炭，自在縱橫。韋緒居士果然丈夫，方且操導禪師之權柄，跨師子尊者之閫閾，說甚麼三界塵勞、四生桎梏？更聽一偈：脫卻儒衣著戰袍，丈夫身世等鴻毛，佳筵移到華間飲，一曲清歌月漸高。」上堂。「遊江海，涉山川，尋師訪道為參禪。自從認得曹溪路，有生死，拈將來，我為汝了。」顧左右云：「又恁麼去也。大眾！你不遠千里，擔囊挈缽，走諸方參尊宿。及乎到這裏鬥湊言語，問甚麼向上向下，討山僧頷下涎，何不將箇自己，與你問端，一齊拋卻。更將山僧弄猴猻底圈套，與那繫驢撅子拈放一邊，轉過位來，向枕頭邊床腳下，試一摸索看，或者偶然覓得箇夜光珠連城璧，豈不慶快平生。即如今日眾善人，將七珍八寶和盤拓出，你們總用不著，更向山僧這

ClaimAnchors.Kwic: ，知君也大錯。爭似我天王，一切都不作。東廊來者東廊行，西廊入者西廊坐。菜是淡黃虀，粥是渾纓絡。噇飽憨憨眠，不知紅日過。如此意分明，如此誠灑落。識得自家底，不須妄穿鑿。」拈拄杖，喝一喝，曰：「若也都不會，又去走驢腳。」上堂。「喚作竹篦則觸，不喚作竹篦則背。不得有語，不得無語。速道！速道！古人如此，大似逼死蛇作活龍。天王今日看來，也不消得。」遂舉拄杖曰：「喚作拄杖也得，不喚作拄杖也得。喚作山河大地也得，不喚作山河大地也得。喚作諸人鼻孔也得，不喚作諸人鼻孔也得。不見道，此事如珠在盤，不滯一隅。」誕日，金粟回，上堂。「古今無二道，聖凡總一揆。生滅空中華，去來水中月。生佛未形前，試看何面目？所以寓叟今日生，驢腮馬額得人憎；寓叟今日死，泥牛入海何消息？生生死死句中玄，去去來來玄中旨。十年未蹋來時路，三徑蕭蕭苔蘚布。今朝善士結勝因，華開十月正陽春。年年記得今日事，諸佛如來實降生。」大心剃度，請上堂。舉：「達磨祖師曰：『吾本來茲上，傳法救迷情。一華開五葉，結果自然成。』」師曰：「養子之緣，故當如斯。天王也有一偈舉似諸人：吾本來茲土，說法覓知音。子期無處見，空彈世上琴。琴，琴！何幸鶴澤畔，相逢一大心。」天王寺立二碑，兼碑文入荊州志，上堂。「達磨西來意，無碑可載傳。唯憑心地印，千古播人寰。雖然，神禹篆文岣嶁，秦皇刻石泰山，羊祜、杜預沉碑襄水，各紀其德，垂之後世。唯吾祖至真之道，天地虛空為碑，日月星辰為文，炳然常燿，文彩全彰。欲紀其道，正如空中鐫鳥蹟，水裏繪魚蹤。何則？蓋所紀者名，名者實之賓，於事即得，於理未可，然事即理也。天王道悟禪師之碑，唐荊南節度使丘公手撰，載於皇藏。悟嗣馬祖，傳其法，有龍潭崇信、雲門法眼，為世系嫡血。後有無識者，混爭為祖，萬口喁喁，竟不能得者。賴有此碑，今寺鼎興，重樹豐碑，鄭工部顯雲居為文，仍附大藏；胡驛憲修入郡乘。千載之下，宗派分明，疑情永息。」卓拄杖曰：「一言截斷千差路，不是曹娥讀夜碑。」上堂。「流泉是命，湛寂是身。千波競起，是文殊境界；一亙晴空，是普賢床榻。古德只解扶起，不解放倒。」拈拄杖曰：「一拳拳倒黃鶴樓，一趯趯翻鸚鵡洲。文殊普賢無處覓，釋迦彌勒是他奴。荊江千里飛帆急，巫峽猿啼過客愁。汝道孔明因甚在廟裏彈指？」還燈敏薦親，請上堂。「昔那吒太子析肉還母、析骨還

ClaimAnchors.Kwic: 撥開千嶂。雲：打一圓相。云：放出一輪月。光未生時薦得親，依然眼裏重添屑。靠拄杖，下座。上堂，舉：廓侍者問德山：從上諸聖向什麼處去？山云：作麼？作麼？廓云：勑點飛龍馬，跛鱉出頭來。山休去。明日浴出，廓過茶與山，山拊廓背云：昨日公案如何？廓云：這老漢今日方始鱉地。師云：編虎鬚、撩虎尾則不無，這僧幾不免於虎口。老德山雖則徹底放憨，要且瞞光孝眼不得。上堂。盡大地是諸人本來面目，因什麼眼不見鼻孔？直饒倜儻分明，未免錯認驢鞍橋作阿爺下頷。且世界未立、父母未生已前如何通信？良久，云：少年曾決龍蛇陣，老倒慵聽稚子歌。謝首座、藏主、維那，上堂。砧椎未動已前，一大藏教字義炳然，三世諸佛口挂壁上。正常恁麼時，且道是誰家風月、人天眼目、古今牓樣？便下座。上堂：凡所有相，皆是虗妄。懷州牛喫禾，益州馬腹脹。若見諸相非相，即見如來。一切難捨，無過己財。驀舉拂子召大眾云：釋迦老子來也，還見麼？良久云：巡堂喫茶去。上堂，舉：達磨大師頌云：吾本來茲土，傳法救迷情，一華開五葉，結果自然成。師云：以左道惑民，必殺無赦。然雖如是，不因柳毅傳書信，爭見龍王宮殿深？久雨，上堂。拈拄杖，畫圓相，召大眾，云：還見麼？赫日當空。擲下拄杖，云：群陰自伏。便下座。上堂，舉：法眼示眾云：盡十方世界，皎皎地無一絲頭。若有一絲頭，即是一絲頭。師云：歷相六國，未是良謀；餓死首陽，豈為奇䇿？古人鬼家活計，為諸人點破了也。還知光孝立地處麼？良久，云：縣古槐根出，官清馬骨高。源首座至，上堂。一不得向，二不得背，絲毫及不盡，古鏡生瑕纇。驀拈拄杖，云：拈起鐵蒺䔧。卓一下，云：一時俱擊碎。擲下拄杖，云：從教大地黑漫漫，它家自有通人會。上堂。會則事同一家。拍禪床一下，云：且道浮幢王剎海外還有這箇消息也無？不會則萬別千差。衲僧家行但行、坐但坐，萬別千差有什麼過？良久，云：參。上堂。盡大地是諸人自己，草芥人畜向甚處著？直饒見得透脫，正是老鼠孔裏作活計。左邊拍禪床一下，云：拈向這邊著，只如常啼菩薩賣却心肝，畢竟教誰學般若？良久，云：罪不重科。上堂。正人說邪法，邪法悉皆正；邪人說正法，正法悉皆邪。驀召大眾，云：與其譽堯而非桀，孰若兩忘而化於道？然雖如是，時人應笑我，解笑者還稀。聖節，上堂。瑞慶聖節，不免講一遍人王護國經，祝延聖壽。乃竪起拂子，召大眾，云：

ClaimAnchors.Kwic: 見鼻孔。進云：曹溪流，非止水，一滴忽來，千波競起時如何？師云：退後，退後。進云：平生不解藏人善，到處逢人說項斯。師云：莫謗山僧好。又僧問：天不言，四時行；地不言，萬物生。學人有疑，願聞開示。師云：萬人遐仰處，紅日到天心。進云：野老不知堯舜力，鼕鼕打鼓祭江神。師云：眼見如盲，口說如啞。進云：千古華山山脚下，又添潘閬倒騎驢。師便喝，僧禮拜，師乃云：建法幢，立宗旨，拓開無上妙門，顯示第一義諦。天何寬？地何窄？青山不青，白雲不白。十字街頭醉翁子，夢裡惺惺；三家村裡臭胡猻，甚生標格。掀翻是非窠窟，截斷凡聖蹤由。德山棒頭，全彰大用；臨濟喝下，脫體風流。垂衣正裳。聖天子繼唐虞之化。修文偃武。賢宰相霈霖雨之秋。所以道。一毛見神變。一切佛同說。經於無量劫。不得其邊際。喝一喝云。將謂合有恁麼說話。拈拄杖云。拄杖子穿過諸人鼻孔即不問。梁寶公騎佛殿出山門。畢竟成得箇什麼事。卓拄杖云。千尺鯨噴洪浪飛。一聲雷震清猋起。復舉：祖師云：吾本來此土，傳法救迷情，一華開五葉，結果自然成。五祖法演和尚云：達磨大師信脚來，信口道，後代兒孫多成計較。諸人要會開華結果處麼？鄭州梨，青州棗，萬物無過出處好。師云：提本分鉗鎚，碎情解窠窟，還他五祖老人要見開華結果處則大遠在。諸人要會開華結果處麼？拈却鄭州梨，放下青州棗，出門便是長安道。久立，珍重！小參。鳳凰臺上對三山，嘯月眠雲趣自閑，一疏忽從天外至，又移身入閙籃間。是知道人行處如火消氷，動靜去來該他不著，一抽三、二添四，截鐵斬釘、和泥合水，有來由、無本據，擊碎上頭關，千華生碓觜。豈不見長沙和尚云：百尺竿頭坐底人，雖然得入未為真，百竿尺頭重進步，十方世界見全身。拈拄杖，云：騎駿馬，驟高樓，萬里銀河輥玉毬。卓拄杖，云：有時乘好月，不覺過滄洲。復舉：德山小參不答話，問話者三十棒。時有僧出，德山劈脊便棒，僧云：某甲話也未問，因甚便打？山云：你是甚處人？僧云：新羅人。山云：未跨船舷，好與三十棒。後來此菴元和尚拈云：忒殺倚勢欺人，山僧見處也要諸人共知。者僧當時若是箇漢，待他道：你是甚處人？便與掀倒禪床，踢起便行。直饒德山牙如劍樹、口似血盆，也須倒退三千。何故？識法者懼。師云：德山正令當行，者僧黠兒落節；若謂倚勢欺人，屈他先德不少。雖然，還知此菴老人落處麼？劍為不平離寶匣，藥因救病

Senses.PreferredTarget: One leaf falls, and the whole world is autumn
SearchAliases: one leaf falls, and the whole world is autumn
Senses.Note: A single leaf falls, and the saying names autumn everywhere. Miyun asks whether the leaf must actually fall for the season to be known. Tian’an places it beside one speck of dust gathering the earth. Hanyu throws down a whisk and asks whether his listeners have seen autumn; Neishao makes the leaf a direct seasonal address. Baiyu opens a new abbacy with the same shift from small to vast. Guantao speaks it at the end of retreat, Liao’an joins it to the passing of youth, and Yushan asks what everyday movement already reveals. One visible change becomes a test of the whole situation.

Senses.PreferredTarget: In one place, it is found without seeking
SearchAliases: in one place, it is found without seeking
Senses.Note: “In one place, it is found without seeking” comes from an older sermon that contrasts fruitless searching everywhere with an unsearched finding. Wuhuan asks for the place and points to privy and Buddha hall. Huigong asks where the supposed thief’s goods are; Zhuan warns that fixing on a place still misses it. Huiyue sets several critiques beside one another, Pinjixiang asks what the finding is, and Suru reverses the formula. Their turns keep the paradox from becoming a map to a special site.

Senses.Note: The saying warns that if one point does not open, efforts on both sides lose their effect. Two masters use it to stop a monk's poorly timed display; Yanxi extends it to every path of obstruction; Shitian places it beside a staff gesture and says he can still rescue half. The line is a test of a blocked response, not a count of two literal locations.

Senses.Explanation: Break through at one point and a thousand, ten thousand points are broken through all at once: Yuanwu uses the formula for a breakthrough that is not confined to the single case where it occurred. In commenting on Mazu twisting Baizhang's nose, Yuanwu Keqin says the encounter must be turned back to oneself without a gap through the day; when one place is penetrated, all the others are penetrated at once. In the Daowu and Jianyuan bones case, he repeats the same line and directs the hearer to penetrate where neither ‘alive’ nor ‘dead’ is given. The number is expansive rather than statistical: one verified opening is tested by whether the rest of the record ceases to remain separate obstruction. Because both exact uses are in the Blue Cliff Record, the entry remains provisional.

Senses.Explanation: Huineng defines ‘single conduct in every activity’ as carrying a straightforward mind without attachment through walking, standing, sitting, and lying down. His Platform Record explicitly rejects immobile sitting and suppression of thoughts as its meaning, calling that account like insentient things and an obstruction to the Way. The Patriarchal Hall Collection preserves the parallel definition: in every place and posture, all is one straightforward mind; this is the site of the Way and the pure land. Qisong’s praise of another Platform edition gives a distinct formulation within the compound, ‘the single aspect of the realm of things,’ under which many different good acts are made correct in one conduct. The entry therefore retains both the direct definitions and the explicit rejected definition.

Senses.Explanation: A word or half a phrase is a deliberately small verbal opening: in these records it may give an entrant a place to enter, expose what years of residence have not resolved, or strike with the force of an implement. Fayan says the ancients lower it to give people an entry; Dahui contrasts immediate recognition through it with decades without a landing; Yuanwu refuses to treat it as a lifetime possession and instead tests what such speech does when it is uttered.

Senses.Explanation: "Once a word is spoken, even a four-horse team cannot catch it" pictures speech outrunning the fastest pursuit. These masters use the proverb to make a reply or teaching move consequential. Tianyin uses the proverb when withholding a further point; Tianan offers it as an answer about the monastery furnace. Baichi answers a hall question with it; Shengke speaks it during a residence opening. Qianshan uses it in a case appraisal, while Yushan gives it as his answer to a question about teaching.

Entries.SourceTerm: 一身去住非去住，二物無情似有情

Senses.PreferredTarget: This body comes and goes without coming or going; the two insentient things seem to have feeling
SearchAliases: this body comes and goes without coming or going; the two insentient things seem to have feeling
Senses.Note: In Huanglong Huinan's return verse, a stream sends him away and clouds welcome him back. His body appears to come and go without a fixed coming or going; stream and cloud, though without feeling, seem to answer him. Baichi composes a new return verse, Guxue asks what in a present journey does not come or go, and Shuijian weighs Huanglong against Ying'an. Hansong objects that Huanglong still treats welcome and farewell as two sides. The couplet makes a travel scene a test of attachment to motion and rest.

Senses.Explanation: Huanglong's verse makes the stream and clouds greet his travels, then questions whether his body truly comes or goes. Baichi answers the old verse with a return verse; Guxue tests which part of a journey is beyond coming and going. Shuijian compares two older travel verses; Hansong criticizes Huanglong for still keeping a trace of arrival and departure.

Senses.Explanation: One wheel of bright moon — the corpus's round light for the whole mind, sung at midnight, sealed on the wave-heart, printed on a thousand rivers, and won at last by great doubt. Shishuang Chuyuan's twelve-hour song, versified at a monk's request, runs the day down to its turn: dusk at the hour of the dog, the sun fallen west of the mountain and fox-spirits abroad; stillness at the hour of the boar, rats swarming at the bed's head; midnight at the hour of the rat — one wheel of bright moon, su-lu-li; and Danxia Zichun's verse on the Yunzhu case — who is the teacher of the buddhas? Manjusri pricks up his ears: in the light without marks no body has yet portended, pure void far and neighborless — one wheel of bright moon shining before the porch; the jade hall silent, no one to be seen. Wujian Xiandu, versifying Baizhang's wild fox: neither falling nor obscuring, a forced name-model — in the still night the empty hall hushed and quiet, one wheel of bright moon lighting the level lake; and Chushi Fanqi, praising the Great One of Compassion: by the vajra rock Sudhana comes calling, and inevitably compassion serves as the guide — just say that what stands present cannot be spoken: one wheel of bright moon in the cold pool. Wuyi Yuanlai, opening the hall at Dongyan: coming without the marks of coming, seeing without the marks of seeing; to seek right wisdom, seek it amid the sixty-two views — a few white clouds crossing the valley mouth; to seek release, seek it in the mind-conduct of beings — one wheel of bright moon sealing the wave-heart; Suru Honghan, pressed into the seat by the prefect and the patrons: one household's business, a hundred households busied — and what is this ascending the hall, after all? — striking the wish-gem: only watch — the blue sky's cloud-breath stilled, one wheel of bright moon printing a thousand rivers; and Minshu Ruxiang: waist-pack ten thousand miles to Mount Wutai, answered with the front-three and the back-three — today great doubt at last has its awakening, one wheel of bright moon lighting the cold pool: great doubt, great awakening; small doubt, small awakening; no doubt, no awakening.

Senses.Explanation: A turning word is a reply sought at the pivot of an encounter, one that changes how the case is handled rather than a fixed formula. Tianyi asks for one at the Buddha-and-demon impasse, the wild-fox story asks Baizhang for one, and Baizhang tests a successor with one. Tianyin, Feiyin, Baichi, and Tianan each use the term for a fresh response needed in a distinct current teaching. Retained public meaning is supported by independent present uses in recorded discourse.

Senses.Explanation: To take the hook at the first cast is to be caught immediately by a question, lure, or testing move. Occurrences.Kwic: 人半人開口不識語路，踏步不知高低，要登主人堂，入主人室，也恐未得在。如今大事為你不得，小事各自知當，彼此不須敗闕，牌且納還上方。僧問：少林首傳二祖，五葉芬芳；葱嶺單提隻履，千燈續焰。門庭雖有五家，般若同歸地位。如何是五家宗旨？答云：有口只堪喫飯。進云：若不借問，怎達本源？答云：未敢相許。進云：如何是溈仰宗？答云：父慈子孝。進云：如何是臨濟宗？答云：迅雷不及掩耳。進云：如何是曹洞宗？答云：三更不借夜明簾。進云：如何是雲門宗？答云：體露金風。進云：如何是法眼宗？答云：山自青，水自綠。進云：五家宗派蒙師指，向上宗乘事若何？答云：頭頂天，脚踏地。進云：今日座元禪師為眾普說，還有為人處也無？答云：你面皮厚多少？進云：但得雪消去，自然春到來。禮拜，歸眾。師乃竪起拂子云：這一隊太平奸賊，割據一統乾坤，有殃害平人之惡，被拂子一時擒下，縛作一束，號令在這裡了也。還見麼？若也未見，待與從頭點過。以拂子擊一下，三玄三要；又擊一下，五位君臣；又擊一下，一鏃破三關，分明箭後路；又擊一下，三界惟心，萬法惟識；又擊一下，絲來線去，明暗相投。既是贓證一一分明，如今却作麼生結絕？連擊兩下。乃云：佛法無人說，雖慧不能了。只如諸方老宿匡徒領眾三百、五百、一千，浩浩地擊動牛皮皷、擺動牛尾巴，又豈是無說？又如盡大地人著衣免寒、喫飯免饑，更要了箇什麼？又何待你板頭下一箇黃面漢子攙匙亂筯、搖唇鼓舌作什麼？雖然，你畢竟喚什麼作佛？又喚什麼作法？了與不了又作麼生？忽若有箇生鐵鑄就底漢捩轉面皮，喝散大眾，掀倒禪床，豈不慶快平生，話行天下？若是邯鄲學唐步，放過也恐未得在。有麼？有麼？現前諸尊上，既是袖裡藏鋒，冷觀敗闕，莫怪向淨潔地上撮些子沙土，撒在你後生晚進眼裏去也。山河大地，明暗色空，豈不是佛是法？風動塵起，鴉鳴鵲噪，豈不是佛是法？四時代謝，萬物榮枯，天晴日頭出，雨落地下濕，豈不是佛是法？以至真如般若，菩提涅槃，無明煩惱，妄想顛倒，行住坐臥，折旋俯仰，豈不是佛是法？這箇是諸方叢林中學得底家常茶飯，有什麼交涉？既無交涉，又莫是泥龕塑像，黃卷赤軸，是佛是法麼？又莫是即心非心，亦有亦無，半合半開，是佛是法麼？又莫是麻三斤，乾屎橛，庭前栢樹子，是佛是法麼？又莫是觀世音將錢買胡餅，放下手元來是饅頭，蝦䗫𨁝跳上天，蚯蚓驀過東海，是佛

Occurrences.Kwic: 溟水。你輩茄子、瓠子那裏知得？拍禪牀便起。聖節，上堂。僧問：佛祖因緣即不問，君臣慶會事如何？師云：瑞草生嘉運，林花結早春。進云：如何是君？師云：莫觸龍顏。進云：如何是臣？師云：量材補職。進云：如何是臣向君？師云：赤心片片。進云：如何是君視臣？師云：如月入水。進云：如何是君臣道合？師云：俱。乃舉：無著與外道論義，著云：天下太平，國王長壽。外道杜口不能破。師頌云：義有河沙數，不出這一句。蚊子上鐵牛，無你下觜處。上堂：眉毛雖長不礙眼，鼻孔雖高不礙面。諸佛雖悟無二心，眾生雖迷無二見。見不見，倒騎牛兮入佛殿。佛涅槃，上堂。披胷示眾，云：要見釋迦老子，向這裏識取。汝等善觀吾紫磨金色之身，今日則有，明日則無。咄！這野狐精縮頭去。過去諸佛亦如是，現在諸佛亦如是，未來諸佛亦如是。卓拄杖，云：如是，如是。又卓一下，云：不是，不是。進退兩序。上堂：東邊的東邊去，西邊的西邊去。去去實不去，生鐵稱錘被蟲蛀。來來實不來，燈籠沿壁上天台。且道不動尊居何國土？一鏃破三關，分明箭後路。上堂。心本是佛，造作還非；道不用修，染污不得。只此不染污，是諸佛之所護念。與麼道，早是染污了也。絲毫繫念，三塗業因；瞥爾情生，萬劫覊鎻。所以經云：若以色見我，以音聲求我，是人行邪道，不能見如來。你道那個是如來？銅頭鐵額，鳥嘴魚腮。上堂。見色便見心。大地山河是心。作麼生見。又云。心不見心。無相可得。拈拄杖云。觀世音菩薩變作一條墨漆拄杖子。繞四天下走一遭。回到山僧手裏。却是芭蕉和尚。你有拄杖子。我與你拄杖子。你無拄杖子。我奪却你拄杖子。若作佛法商量。生身陷地獄。靠拄杖。結夏，小參。僧問：大通智勝佛，十劫坐道場，佛法不現前，不得成佛道。此意如何？師云：也無此意，也無如何？進云：未審何時得成佛道？師云：也無佛，也無道。進云：莫落空否？師云：空亦空。進云：即今道空的是什麼人？師云：這漆桶。進云：本來無罣礙，隨處任方圓。師云：玄沙道底。乃云：以大圓覺為我伽藍，身心安居，平等性智。召眾云：性智既然平等，說什麼聖？說什麼凡？說什麼迷？說什麼悟？古也如是，今也如是，僧也如是，俗也如是，出出入入，何礙安居？往往來來，是真禁足。譬如蟭螟蟲在蚊子眼睫上作窠，向十字街頭叫云：土曠人稀，相逢者少。復有頌云：金毛獅子喋屎狗，雪白象王推磨驢，直下不生顛倒

ClaimAnchors.Kwic: 牘至，師許之。住纂峰者一月，住廣長者一期，而嵒頭則優遊往來荊門、玉泉、灃浦、夾山。顓使又迎，師卻不應，乃上衡山埽讓祖最勝輪之塔。福嚴住持佛頂，屬師及門，請開法福嚴。師以興陽稍未卒業，不允，僅一登福嚴之座說法，以結諸山法喜之緣。送容和尚木主入傳法院祖堂，撥棹過荊南，觀慧海所闢天王之席。海率荊人士請上堂說法，復歸棲賢。師二十餘年津梁不倦，六坐道場，隨時拈出。上堂：「法身無相，春色滿園關不住；般若無知，一枝紅杏出牆來。善財童子參見五十三員善知識，末後向樓閣門前了手。富嫌千口少，南嶽思和尚一口吞盡三世諸佛，何處更有眾生可度？貧恨一身多，且道漢鎮街頭袁德謙來此棲賢會裏飯僧，是有所謂也？無所謂也？有所求也？無所求也？」擊拂子曰：「落梅濺石青丸碎，臥柳臨波翠帶長。」上堂：「百步穿楊箭，中者知分曉；當陽陷虎機，識者豈能瞞？好手手中呈好手，敵勝驚群；紅心心裏中紅心，通身慶快。知音漢舉起便行，瞌睡人夢中說夢。山僧今日插標布彩去也，還有搶旂奪鼓者麼？一鏃破三關，分明箭後路。」上堂：「若是一見便了，未為好手。法場久戰，方見作家。作家相見也，開口不在舌頭上；法場久戰也，干戈林裏太平時。得到恁麼田地，用之則行，舒卷立方外乾坤，縱橫挂壺中日月；舍之則藏，榾柮火中煨芋熟，天子三召而不出。必須恁麼人，方能恁麼事。現前還有恁麼人麼？喚來與祖師洗腳。」解制，上堂：「有時把住，佛祖攢眉；有時放行，聖凡得路。今日闌圈既開，放出牛兒馬兒，騰蹋春風，桃華浪裏翻身，百艸頭邊游戲。三級浪高，只貴金鱗燒尾；一聲霹靂，從他攫霧挐雲。手親眼快，平步青霄，滯殼迷封，暴腮點額。眾中還有要風雷相送底麼？」拈棒一齊打散。武昌王司李至，上堂。「惱後圓光，萬別千差俱照徹；驀頭風雨，從教遍界骨毛寒。拋卻家珍，掀翻舊案，縣嵒撒手，自肯承當，絕後再甦，欺君不得。」拍禪床，曰：「隔江招手橫趨去，爭似今朝見面親？」僧問：「楚江河路既通，因甚斷頭船子不到？」師曰：「無你棲泊處。」問：「驀地相逢，三頭六臂，正恁麼時，金不博金一句又作麼生？」師曰：「放汝三十棒。」曰：「不假鉗錘力，分明覿面呈。」師曰：「本分事作麼生？」僧擬議，師曰：「販私鹽漢。」喝出。師之絕情離識，真實相為者若此。且楚之宗風久歇，得師振起，黃鶴樓前、鸚鵡洲邊，古鏡重磨，漢陽覿面，孰謂柔

ClaimAnchors.Kwic: 句？」希曰：「曾問一老宿：『汪洋浪裏乘舟，因甚怕水？』老宿未答。又問：『須彌頂上翹足，因甚遭跌？』老宿亦未答，但曰：『喫茶。』」師云：「何不問老僧？」希舉前語，師云：「弄潮須是弄潮人。」希進後語，師云：「平地無端也喫交。」希云：「謝師答話。」便禮拜，師云：「歸堂去。」師問石靈：「你適才喝箇甚麼？」石云：「喝本來面目。」師云：「本來面目即今何在？」石云：「在眉毛上。」師云：「喚甚麼作眉毛？」石又喝一喝。師云：「你只有者箇伎倆。」師問僧：「那裏來？」僧云：「南方來。」師云：「南方諸師與你說箇甚麼？」僧云：「一言道不盡。」師打一棒，云：「有甚麼道不盡的？」僧一喝便出。師云：「何不早恁麼？」隨後復打。遵義鎮臺闇然吳護法延茶，乃奉一餅云：「請者一片白雲。」師云：「謝供養。」少頃，吳張弓作射勢，師云：「石鞏大師猶在。」時水子劉居士云：「看箭。」乾明禪師云：「不要你償命，看箇甚麼？」師云：「一箭射雙鵰。」吳擲下云：「仙與佛是同是別？」師云：「一鏃破三關，分明箭後路。」蓮月禪師語錄卷第四蓮月禪師語錄卷第五侍者發悟錄法語法語示覺非禪人示覺非禪人欲究行腳中事，先將從前習氣憎愛境緣屏除殆盡，只打理一箇空空蕩蕩身心，入於稠人廣眾之中，卓然自立，或遭人罵，或遭人打，逆順甘苦，皆欲備嘗，一朝踢翻漆桶，庶幾堪與龍象蹴蹋也。示貴筑悟禪人示貴筑悟禪人若論此事，不向外求，只因境緣牽引，迷失無位真人，不見本來面目，遂為生死流轉。忽然回光返照，急欲推尋，如失了極重物，畢竟要親見親得，然後放下，直逼拶到水窮山盡處，驀地相逢。咄！元來在者裏。示月谿禪人示月谿禪人八萬四千功德中，唯般若力最勝、最堅、最利，能割裂世間愛網，能截斷生死根株，但恐不入紅爐，遂成頑鈍。若向辣手邊久經鍛煉，滑石上重加磨礱，露出鋒鋩，豈肯稍涉一毫之𦆆纖耶？示字浪禪人示字浪禪人派遠流長，佛法原無古今；世異事殊，人心亦有隆替。所賴苦志衲子辨箇鐵石身心，不隨人起倒，或行腳、或住山，全身擔荷此事，必要做到出頭處去，縱處荊棘劍鋒，亦不惜性命也。勉之。示松巖禪人示松巖禪人松巖禪人，出俗年幼，浪跡夜郎，夙因奇遘。甘苦眾中，進前退後，先聖宗乘，未曾專究。空過青春，徒消白晝，寒暑迭遷，齒缺面皺。臥病巴山，莫能自救，感慨欷歔，罪向誰首？今日重逢，眼目如舊，何似回光

ClaimAnchors.Kwic: 如何？」師云：「日長一線。」進云：「衲僧分上又作麼生？」師云：「不遂四時凋。」進云：「恁麼則衲被蒙頭跏趺坐，一鑪榾柮煖烘烘。」師云：「照顧眉毛。」師乃拍桌一下，大眾齊顧視，師展開兩手示之，便下座。上堂。問：「獅子遊行即不問，前護後擁事如何？」師云：「人天圍繞。」進云：「恁麼則哮吼一聲，清風滿座。」師云：「諕殺一堂人。」進云：「者老漢更出一頭地去也。」師云：「莫謗他好。」乃云：「樹凋葉落，顯覿體之真乘；人法兩忘，示本然之密旨。到者裏，全彰本分，毫沒囊藏，應物隨機，一團活潑。雖然如是，且道：放行為人好？把住為人好？休從兔角尋長短，莫向空花問淺深。」上堂。問：「衝開壁立萬初，擊碎鐵額銅頭，未審還有向上事也無？」師云：「行人更在青山外。」進云：「昨日法雷轟宇宙，今朝衝破釣鰲磯。」師云：「穿卻汝鼻孔。」乃云：「龜毛拂子迅如風，兔角烏藤活似龍，彈指拂開千丈石，嗽聲透過萬重峰。到恁麼時，指山山崩，點海海竭，不是神通妙用，亦非法爾如然。還會麼？一鏃破三關，分明箭後路。」上堂。「八面玲瓏徹底穿，通身渾箇不相瞞，臨機隨便拈來用，不是拳頭便腳尖。到恁麼時，更待分賓立主，問答三玄，不惟鈍置殺人，亦乃墮坑落塹。若是當家種草，觸處分明，不動纖毫，一場事畢。只如大用現前一句如何指陳？巨靈抬手無多子，分破華山千萬重。」寂慧薦親，上堂。「箇事從來絕覆藏，包羅天地了無雙，即今示汝無藏者，元是當初申大郎。只這裏離四句、絕百非，金剛體塞，太虛常寂，光輝萬象，八字打開，和盤托出。還會麼？七寶池邊聞法意，九蓮臺上現金容。」下座。上堂。問：「金鐘罷扣，玉磬高停，和尚如何指示？」師云：「其聲若雷。」進云：「恁麼則耀古騰今去也。」師云：「汝將甚麼聞？」僧喝，師打，乃云：「一不立，無孔鐵錘當面擲，無端穿卻諸人眼，只要男兒自點頭，不論根機利鈍。初學久參，貴乎直下承當，機前擔荷，會中還有擔荷得者麼？試通箇消息看。」眾無語，復云：「巨鰲潭上無音信，徒向磯前下一鉤。」上堂。「昔日釋迦老子要箇無眼、耳、鼻、舌、身、意的擔當箇事。何故聻？不萌枝上藏香象，無底籃能捉活龍。昨夜拄杖子道：『要箇有眼、耳、鼻、舌、身、意的擔當箇事，何故聻？摘破香囊燻大國，撥開天竅吼真風。』山僧又即不然，有眼、耳、鼻、舌、身、意的也不用，無眼、耳、鼻、舌、身

ClaimAnchors.Kwic: 說到，一狀領過。缺齒老臊胡，嵩山破竈墮。上堂，拈拄杖云：若喚作拄杖子，埋沒己靈；不喚作拄杖子，辜負先聖。擲下拄杖。豈不見雲門大師道：一大藏教，只說者箇。歲旦，上堂：元正新改旦，舉則舊公案。料掉沒交涉，閏年春色晚。上堂：欲見太平，須撥亂乾坤。欲求知己，須掀翻海嶽。淨慈沒者閑工夫，端坐受供養，施主長安樂。閏二月，上堂：大盡小盡，三年一閏。全提半提，眼上安眉。有誵訛，沒巴鼻。放過一著，落在第二。上堂：從來共住不知名，漆桶漆桶。任運相將只麼行，只恐不恁麼。自古上賢猶不識，癩兒牽伴。造次凡流豈可明，賴有者一句。上堂：從上已來，一人傳虗，萬人傳實。便是棒頭喝下，截鐵斬釘，也只屙漉漉地。乃竪起拂子云：者箇因甚却到今日？解夏，小參。佛法二千年，毫髮不移；山中九十日，終始無間。窮十方三世，盡此土西天，一切處不留，一切處成就。何必南詢在在覺城，東際不勞彈指，日月樓閣門開，衲僧門下未為極則。若是箇漢，不墮時人功幹，不涉諸佛階梯。畢竟如何？拍禪牀，云：一鏃破三關，分明箭後路。復舉：巴陵和尚問僧云：遊山來？為佛法來？僧云：清平世界說甚麼佛法？陵云：好箇無事禪客。僧云：早是多事了也。陵云：上座去年曾在此過夏來？僧云：不曾。陵云：與麼則先來不相識。下去。師云：巴陵可謂孟嘗之門，者僧亦自慣能作客，進則進，退則退，直是賓主諧和。只如巴陵道：與麼則先來不相識下去。意在於何？三盞酒裝公子面，一枝花插美人頭。上堂：馬祖陞堂，百丈卷席。淨慈看來，寸不如尺。上堂。雲門放洞山三頓棒，嚼飯餧嬰孩；黃檗打臨濟三頓棒，按牛頭喫草。只今不犯絲毫，有箇方便。良久，云：大事為你不得，小事自家擔當。至節，上堂。群陰剝盡一陽來。復拈拄杖，云：拄杖子隨鄉入俗。卓一下，六六不成三十六。上堂。舉一明三，問十答百，風塵草動，剔起便行，一箇箇謾他一點不得。伸手云：我手何似佛手？除夜，小參。一塵入正受，乾坤寂爾；諸塵三昧起，世界崢嶸。便見年窮歲盡，物換時移，東村王老夜燒錢，張公喫酒李公醉，直下大機頓發，不妨正眼流通。正與麼時，還有物不遷義也無？喝一喝。復舉：古德云：我若向你道，又怕禿却我舌；我若不向你道，又怕啞却我口。還有為人處也無？師云：說也說了，註也註了，意圖為人，却成賺人。歲旦，上堂。昨夜送殘年，今朝賀新歲，無量法門，百千三昧。拍禪牀，

ClaimAnchors.Kwic: 人半人開口不識語路，踏步不知高低，要登主人堂，入主人室，也恐未得在。如今大事為你不得，小事各自知當，彼此不須敗闕，牌且納還上方。僧問：少林首傳二祖，五葉芬芳；葱嶺單提隻履，千燈續焰。門庭雖有五家，般若同歸地位。如何是五家宗旨？答云：有口只堪喫飯。進云：若不借問，怎達本源？答云：未敢相許。進云：如何是溈仰宗？答云：父慈子孝。進云：如何是臨濟宗？答云：迅雷不及掩耳。進云：如何是曹洞宗？答云：三更不借夜明簾。進云：如何是雲門宗？答云：體露金風。進云：如何是法眼宗？答云：山自青，水自綠。進云：五家宗派蒙師指，向上宗乘事若何？答云：頭頂天，脚踏地。進云：今日座元禪師為眾普說，還有為人處也無？答云：你面皮厚多少？進云：但得雪消去，自然春到來。禮拜，歸眾。師乃竪起拂子云：這一隊太平奸賊，割據一統乾坤，有殃害平人之惡，被拂子一時擒下，縛作一束，號令在這裡了也。還見麼？若也未見，待與從頭點過。以拂子擊一下，三玄三要；又擊一下，五位君臣；又擊一下，一鏃破三關，分明箭後路；又擊一下，三界惟心，萬法惟識；又擊一下，絲來線去，明暗相投。既是贓證一一分明，如今却作麼生結絕？連擊兩下。乃云：佛法無人說，雖慧不能了。只如諸方老宿匡徒領眾三百、五百、一千，浩浩地擊動牛皮皷、擺動牛尾巴，又豈是無說？又如盡大地人著衣免寒、喫飯免饑，更要了箇什麼？又何待你板頭下一箇黃面漢子攙匙亂筯、搖唇鼓舌作什麼？雖然，你畢竟喚什麼作佛？又喚什麼作法？了與不了又作麼生？忽若有箇生鐵鑄就底漢捩轉面皮，喝散大眾，掀倒禪床，豈不慶快平生，話行天下？若是邯鄲學唐步，放過也恐未得在。有麼？有麼？現前諸尊上，既是袖裡藏鋒，冷觀敗闕，莫怪向淨潔地上撮些子沙土，撒在你後生晚進眼裏去也。山河大地，明暗色空，豈不是佛是法？風動塵起，鴉鳴鵲噪，豈不是佛是法？四時代謝，萬物榮枯，天晴日頭出，雨落地下濕，豈不是佛是法？以至真如般若，菩提涅槃，無明煩惱，妄想顛倒，行住坐臥，折旋俯仰，豈不是佛是法？這箇是諸方叢林中學得底家常茶飯，有什麼交涉？既無交涉，又莫是泥龕塑像，黃卷赤軸，是佛是法麼？又莫是即心非心，亦有亦無，半合半開，是佛是法麼？又莫是麻三斤，乾屎橛，庭前栢樹子，是佛是法麼？又莫是觀世音將錢買胡餅，放下手元來是饅頭，蝦䗫𨁝跳上天，蚯蚓驀過東海，是佛

ClaimAnchors.Kwic: 溟水。你輩茄子、瓠子那裏知得？拍禪牀便起。聖節，上堂。僧問：佛祖因緣即不問，君臣慶會事如何？師云：瑞草生嘉運，林花結早春。進云：如何是君？師云：莫觸龍顏。進云：如何是臣？師云：量材補職。進云：如何是臣向君？師云：赤心片片。進云：如何是君視臣？師云：如月入水。進云：如何是君臣道合？師云：俱。乃舉：無著與外道論義，著云：天下太平，國王長壽。外道杜口不能破。師頌云：義有河沙數，不出這一句。蚊子上鐵牛，無你下觜處。上堂：眉毛雖長不礙眼，鼻孔雖高不礙面。諸佛雖悟無二心，眾生雖迷無二見。見不見，倒騎牛兮入佛殿。佛涅槃，上堂。披胷示眾，云：要見釋迦老子，向這裏識取。汝等善觀吾紫磨金色之身，今日則有，明日則無。咄！這野狐精縮頭去。過去諸佛亦如是，現在諸佛亦如是，未來諸佛亦如是。卓拄杖，云：如是，如是。又卓一下，云：不是，不是。進退兩序。上堂：東邊的東邊去，西邊的西邊去。去去實不去，生鐵稱錘被蟲蛀。來來實不來，燈籠沿壁上天台。且道不動尊居何國土？一鏃破三關，分明箭後路。上堂。心本是佛，造作還非；道不用修，染污不得。只此不染污，是諸佛之所護念。與麼道，早是染污了也。絲毫繫念，三塗業因；瞥爾情生，萬劫覊鎻。所以經云：若以色見我，以音聲求我，是人行邪道，不能見如來。你道那個是如來？銅頭鐵額，鳥嘴魚腮。上堂。見色便見心。大地山河是心。作麼生見。又云。心不見心。無相可得。拈拄杖云。觀世音菩薩變作一條墨漆拄杖子。繞四天下走一遭。回到山僧手裏。却是芭蕉和尚。你有拄杖子。我與你拄杖子。你無拄杖子。我奪却你拄杖子。若作佛法商量。生身陷地獄。靠拄杖。結夏，小參。僧問：大通智勝佛，十劫坐道場，佛法不現前，不得成佛道。此意如何？師云：也無此意，也無如何？進云：未審何時得成佛道？師云：也無佛，也無道。進云：莫落空否？師云：空亦空。進云：即今道空的是什麼人？師云：這漆桶。進云：本來無罣礙，隨處任方圓。師云：玄沙道底。乃云：以大圓覺為我伽藍，身心安居，平等性智。召眾云：性智既然平等，說什麼聖？說什麼凡？說什麼迷？說什麼悟？古也如是，今也如是，僧也如是，俗也如是，出出入入，何礙安居？往往來來，是真禁足。譬如蟭螟蟲在蚊子眼睫上作窠，向十字街頭叫云：土曠人稀，相逢者少。復有頌云：金毛獅子喋屎狗，雪白象王推磨驢，直下不生顛倒

Senses.Explanation: One arrowhead pierces three gates; the path in its wake lies clear pictures a decisive move that opens a route through several barriers. Shaweng gives the pair after inviting someone to seize the banner and drum. Lianyue uses it as his answer to whether immortal and Buddha are the same or different. Dabo gives it after asking whether the assembly recognizes a powerful move. Yanxi gives it after warning that an ordinary sighting is still short of the matter. Xueyan places it with other schools’ characteristic devices while striking his whisk. Chushi gives it after asking where a motionless figure dwells.

Senses.Explanation: One arrow crosses the open sky is Xuedou's compact line within a verse on Yunmen's three phrases. Senses.Explanation: The first yang returns: at the winter solstice, Chan speakers use the start of renewed growth to ask what changes and what remains steady. Hanxiu Ruqian opens a solstice discourse with the first yang's return and the beginning of growth. Wuzhun Shifan pairs the turn with thawing valleys and asks whether this is the Buddha's teaching or the ordinary world. Tian'an Sheng joins it to day-and-night effort, using a bean bursting from cold ashes as the test. Fushi Tongxian places the return beside an unmoving source and says that seeing the source changes how one meets the seasons. Lianyue Daozheng speaks the seasonal turn after questioning a monk about winter and then makes it the start of growth. Meixi Fudu describes the turn as benefitting many beings, while his staff remains unmoved. Shiqi Tongyun declares the return after the retreat of darkness and asks for a word of complete freedom. Zixian Jue places it among thawing rivers and breaking buds, then cautions that the extra daylight should not be wasted.

Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (X/X79/X79n1557.xml). Essential Compendium of the United Lamp (聯燈會要): Xuedou Chongxian comments that Jiashan did not know he had exchanged for one eye. The exact headword-bearing actor is Xuedou Chongxian

Senses.Explanation: In the records, ‘one eye’ is a figurative capacity used in appraisals: it may be possessed, placed, lost, exchanged, or opened, without the texts supplying a single assertion about what it sees. Literally "one" (一) classifier (隻) "eye" (眼): "one eye," attested 992 times in 233 texts. The records use it in appraisals with the verbs possess, place, lose, exchange, and open. In the Damei case, Jiashan says, "at Damei I lost one eye" (我當時在大梅，失却一隻眼); Xuedou comments that Jiashan did not know he had then "exchanged for one eye" (換得一隻眼). Another appraisal says Yunmen "possesses only one eye" because he "only looks ahead and does not look behind" (只具一隻眼，只管瞻前，不管照後). Productive forms include "possess one eye" (具一隻眼, 476 occurrences), "place one eye here" (著得一隻眼, 89), "lose one eye" (失却一隻眼, 91), and "open another eye" (別開一隻眼).

Senses.Explanation: One beating with the staff is a countable punitive or testing action, not the wooden object itself. Hall speakers award everyone a beating, ask where it would land, or say a participant remains unable to turn after receiving one. Case commentators argue that a participant should demand the beating owed him. The grammar distinguishes this act from the broader staff entry as an implement: it is received, deserved, demanded, or used to drive someone out.

Senses.Explanation: Mountains of knives and forests of swords form a paired image of punitive terrain. The retained records do not leave it as a literal destination: they place awakening there, ask what such torments can do to a person, call the frightening forms compassionate responsiveness, or say the terrain is simply at ease. Tiantai Deshao says that awakening occurs on mountains of knives and forests of swords, in boiling cauldrons and furnaces, beneath blows, and beneath shouts. Juelang Daosheng lists the pair among punishments and asks what any of them has ever been able to do to you. Zhuanyu Guanheng places the pair beside spears and halberds, then calls all of them scenes of complete responsiveness and the basis of compassion. Yuejiang Zhengyin's verse pairs awakening in furnaces and cauldrons with mountains of knives and forests of swords being simply at ease.

Senses.PreferredTarget: a knife cannot cut into it
Senses.Note: The words describe resistance to cutting, but the corpus bends that image in opposite evaluative directions; hardness alone is therefore not a verdict of attainment.

Senses.Explanation: A knife cannot cut into it: the phrase presents something no blade can penetrate. Yuansou Duan gives it as ‘the solid statement,’ Yi'an answers ‘What is Buddha?’ with it, while Yunwai Xingze and Faxi Yin use the same hardness critically or comparatively rather than as praise by definition. Nanyue Jiqi quotes Yuansou Duan's answer and immediately rejects it before offering his own. Yi'an gives the phrase directly as an answer about Buddha. Yunwai Xingze warns that an axe-and-knife-proof rigidity can still be dead stillness, whereas Faxi Yin compares the assembly's condition to that of the old masters.

Senses.Explanation: Xueyan ends a spring scene by complaining that the mountain’s hundred-tongued bird also imitates Jiangnan’s cuckoo, then asks whether his own saying belongs to guest or host. Xueyan Zuqin names the slow spring day, thinning blossoms, the mountain bird, and the cuckoo’s reported call. He immediately turns the whole utterance into a public question—guest’s words or host’s words?—and warns the assembly not to repeat it wrongly. The Complete Five Lamps transmits the same address.
